你.mnemonic: A person '亻' stands beside '尔', pointing straight at you: 'Hey, YOU!'

好.mnemonic: A woman '女' holding her child '子' — what could be more good than that?
好.example_en: The weather is very good today.

我.mnemonic: A hand '手' gripping a halberd '戈' to defend ME — this weapon is mine!
我.components: pictograph of a pronged weapon; visually 手 hand + 戈 halberd

是.mnemonic: The sun '日' sits squarely over a correct, upright base — it IS so, as true as daylight.
是.components: 日 sun + 𤴓 (form of 疋, related to 正 correct)

不.mnemonic: A line '一' blocks a sprouting root from pushing up — NO, it may not grow.
不.components: pictograph (originally a plant root/bud); visually 一 line + 个-like shape

人.mnemonic: Two strokes like a pair of legs walking — a person striding along.
人.components: pictograph of a person walking (two legs)

他.mnemonic: A person '亻' standing next to '也' — that's HIM over there.

她.mnemonic: A woman '女' standing next to '也' — that's HER over there.

吗.mnemonic: A mouth '口' shouting at a horse '马': 'Are you coming?' — every yes/no question.

谢谢.mnemonic: Words '讠' flying like arrows shot '射' straight to someone — twice, to say thank you!
谢谢.components: 谢 thank (讠 speech + 射 shoot) + 谢 thank (doubled)

不客气.mnemonic: Do NOT '不' treat me as a guest '客' with polite air '气' — you're welcome, friend!
不客气.components: 不 not + 客 guest (宀 roof + 各) + 气 air; manners
不客气.example_en: A: Thank you! B: You're welcome.

再见.mnemonic: Hope to see '见' (an eye on legs) you again '再' — goodbye!
再见.components: 再 again + 见 see (simplified from an eye 目 on legs 儿)

一.mnemonic: A single horizontal stroke — one finger lying flat.
一.components: one stroke 一 (pictograph of one counting rod)

二.mnemonic: Two horizontal strokes stacked — two counting sticks.

三.mnemonic: Three horizontal strokes stacked — three counting sticks.
三.example_en: There are three people in our family.

四.mnemonic: A box '囗' with two little legs '儿' inside — a square room with four walls.
四.example_en: My daughter is four years old.

五.mnemonic: Two lines with an X crossing between them — five, the middle of counting to ten.
五.components: 二 two lines + 㐅 cross (originally crossed lines)

六.mnemonic: A little hut: a lid '亠' over two spread legs '八' — six friends sheltering inside.
六.components: 亠 lid + 八 (originally a pictograph of a hut)

七.mnemonic: A cross that has been cut and bent — like the number 7 lying upside down.
七.components: 一 + 乚 crossed (originally a cross meaning 'cut')

八.mnemonic: Two strokes parting away from each other, like a mustache splitting into eight.
八.components: 丿 + 乀 two strokes parting (meaning 'divide')
八.example_en: I go to school at eight o'clock.

九.mnemonic: A bent arm reaching out — stretching almost to the end, nine, one short of ten.
九.components: 丿 + 乙 (pictograph of a bent arm/hook)

十.mnemonic: A complete cross '十' — all ten fingers crossed together.

零.mnemonic: Rain '雨' falling as tiny drops that count for zero.
零.components: 雨 rain + 令 command (phonetic; originally 'drizzle')

几.mnemonic: A tiny low table '几' with only a few things on it — how many?
几.example_en: How many people are in your family?

多少.mnemonic: Many '多' (two evenings '夕' stacked) versus few '少' (small '小' with a slash) — how much?
多少.components: 多 many (夕 + 夕) + 少 few (小 small + 丿)

岁.mnemonic: Each evening '夕' piles up like a mountain '山' of years — how old you are.
岁.example_en: How old are you this year?

爸爸.mnemonic: Father '父' holding the 'ba' '巴' sound — the dad who says 'ba ba'.
爸爸.components: 爸 dad (父 father + 巴 phonetic) + 爸 dad (doubled)

妈妈.mnemonic: A woman '女' riding a horse '马' to fetch you — that's mom!
妈妈.components: 妈 mom (女 woman + 马 phonetic) + 妈 mom (doubled)

儿子.mnemonic: A child '儿' on little legs plus another child '子' — your boy, your son.
儿子.components: 儿 child (legs) + 子 child (noun suffix here)

女儿.mnemonic: A woman '女' who is still a child '儿' — your daughter.
女儿.components: 女 woman; female + 儿 child

家.mnemonic: A pig '豕' under a roof '宀' — in old China, a house with a pig meant home and family.

爱.mnemonic: A hand '爫' reaching down to cover '冖' a friend '友' — that is love.
爱.components: 爫 hand/claw + 冖 cover + 友 friend (traditional 愛 also had 心 heart)

朋友.mnemonic: Two moons '月月' side by side plus two hands '又' clasping — friends together.
朋友.components: 朋 friend (月 + 月, originally strings of shells) + 友 friend (𠂇 hand + 又 hand)

我们.mnemonic: Me '我' plus a person '亻' at the gate '门' — all of us together.
我们.components: 我 I + 们 plural (亻 person + 门 gate, phonetic)

同学.mnemonic: Same '同' room, learning '学' together — the kid '子' at the desk next to you.
同学.components: 同 same (冂 + 一 + 口) + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子 child)

老师.mnemonic: An old '老' person with a cane leading the troops '师' — your teacher.
老师.components: 老 old (耂 + 匕) + 师 teacher; master (simplified from 師)

学生.mnemonic: A child '子' learning '学' while sprouts '生' grow — a growing student.
学生.components: 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子 child) + 生 grow; life (sprout from earth)
学生.example_en: She is a student in Beijing.

先生.mnemonic: The one born '生' first '先' (a foot stepping ahead of a person '儿') — Mr., sir.
先生.components: 先 first (⺧ foot + 儿 person) + 生 born; life

小姐.mnemonic: A small '小' woman '女' — the young lady, Miss.
小姐.components: 小 small + 姐 elder sister (女 woman + 且 phonetic)

叫.mnemonic: A mouth '口' crying out with a tangled '丩' voice — calling your name.

名字.mnemonic: At evening '夕' in the dark you call out with your mouth '口' the name of a child '子' under the roof '宀'.
名字.components: 名 name (夕 evening + 口 mouth) + 字 character; word (宀 roof + 子 child)

认识.mnemonic: Speaking '讠' to a person '人' and talking '讠' about only '只' them — now you know them.
认识.components: 认 recognize (讠 speech + 人 person) + 识 know (讠 speech + 只 phonetic)

吃.mnemonic: A mouth '口' begging '乞' for food — time to eat!

喝.mnemonic: A mouth '口' gulping down a drink — 'hé' ('曷') hints at the sound of drinking.

水.mnemonic: A central stream '亅' with drops splashing off both sides — flowing water.

茶.mnemonic: Grass leaves '艹' on top, a person '人' in the middle, a tree '木' below — picking tea leaves.
茶.components: 艹 grass + 人 person + 木 tree (variant form)

米饭.mnemonic: Grains of rice '米' scattered in four directions, cooked into a meal '饭' for food '饣'.
米饭.components: 米 rice (pictograph of grains) + 饭 meal; cooked rice (饣 food + 反 phonetic)

菜.mnemonic: A hand '爫' picking '采' plants '艹' from a tree '木' — vegetables for the dish.
菜.components: 艹 grass + 采 pick (爫 hand + 木 tree)

苹果.mnemonic: A flat '平' grassy '艹' orchard with fruit '果' hanging on the tree '木' — apples!
苹果.components: 苹 apple (艹 grass + 平 flat, phonetic) + 果 fruit (田 fruit + 木 tree)

水果.mnemonic: Water '水' plus fruit '果' growing on a tree '木' — juicy fruit.
水果.components: 水 water + 果 fruit (田 fruit shape + 木 tree)

杯子.mnemonic: A wooden '木' container that does NOT '不' leak — your cup.
杯子.components: 杯 cup (木 wood + 不 phonetic) + 子 noun suffix

饭店.mnemonic: A shop '店' (a shelter '广' you occupy '占') where food '饭' is served — a restaurant.
饭店.components: 饭 meal (饣 food + 反) + 店 shop (广 shelter + 占 phonetic)
饭店.example_en: Let's go to the restaurant to eat.

买.mnemonic: A hook '乛' over a head '头' — snatching something you want to buy.
买.components: 乛 + 头 (simplified from 買: 网 net + 貝 shell/money)
买.example_en: I'm going to the shop to buy things.

钱.mnemonic: Metal '钅' coins stacked in piles '戋' — money!

块.mnemonic: Earth '土' broken into chunks '夬' — lumps of money, yuan.

商店.mnemonic: A shop '店' (shelter '广') where people trade '商' — the store.
商店.components: 商 trade; commerce + 店 shop (广 shelter + 占 phonetic)

东西.mnemonic: Everything from east '东' to west '西' — all the things and stuff.
东西.example_en: What things do you want to buy?

今天.mnemonic: Now '今' under the sky '天' — today.
今天.components: 今 now; present + 天 sky; day (一 + 大 big person)
今天.example_en: What day of the week is it today?

明天.mnemonic: Sun '日' and moon '月' together make bright '明' — the next bright day, tomorrow.
明天.components: 明 bright (日 sun + 月 moon) + 天 day

昨天.mnemonic: The sun '日' that went suddenly '乍' — the day just gone, yesterday.
昨天.components: 昨 past (日 sun + 乍 phonetic) + 天 day

年.mnemonic: Originally a person carrying a harvest of grain on their back — one harvest each year.
年.components: originally 禾 grain over 人 person (harvest); modern form simplified

月.mnemonic: A crescent moon '月' with two lines of shadow — the moon, and one month.

日.mnemonic: A sun '日' with a dot in the middle, squared off — the sun, and one day.

星期.mnemonic: A star '星' (sun '日' + born '生') rising for a period '期' (its '其' + moon '月') — a week.
星期.components: 星 star (日 + 生) + 期 period (其 + 月 moon)

点.mnemonic: Fire dots '灬' marking a spot '占' on the clock — o'clock, a little dot.

分钟.mnemonic: A knife '刀' dividing '分' time, and a metal '钅' bell '钟' ringing in the middle '中' — minutes.
分钟.components: 分 divide (八 separate + 刀 knife) + 钟 clock; bell (钅 metal + 中 phonetic)

现在.mnemonic: Jade '王' shining as you see '见' it right here '在' — now.
现在.components: 现 appear (王 jade + 见 see) + 在 be at (𠂇 + 土 earth)
现在.example_en: It's three in the afternoon now.

时候.mnemonic: The sun '日' moving an inch '寸' while a person '亻' waits '候' — the moment when.
时候.components: 时 time (日 sun + 寸 inch) + 候 wait; time (亻 person + 丨 + 矦)
时候.example_en: When are you going to Beijing?

上午.mnemonic: Above '上' (before) the noon '午' mark — the morning.
上午.components: 上 up; before (a mark above a line) + 午 noon (pictograph of a pestle)
上午.example_en: I'm at home in the morning.

中午.mnemonic: Right in the middle '中' (an arrow through a target) of noon '午' — midday.
中午.components: 中 middle (口 target + 丨 through it) + 午 noon

下午.mnemonic: Below '下' (after) the noon '午' mark — the afternoon.
下午.components: 下 down; after (a mark below a line) + 午 noon
下午.example_en: I'm going to the shop in the afternoon.

中国.mnemonic: The middle '中' kingdom: jade '玉' guarded inside a border '囗' — China.
中国.components: 中 middle + 国 country (囗 border + 玉 jade)

北京.mnemonic: The north '北' (two people back to back) capital '京' (a tall tower) — Beijing.
北京.components: 北 north (two people back to back) + 京 capital (pictograph of a tall building)

在.mnemonic: A sprout '才' rooted in the earth '土' — it is AT this spot, staying in place.
在.components: 𠂇 + 土 earth (from 才 sprout + 土)

这.mnemonic: Walking '辶' right up to the writing '文' — THIS one here.

那.mnemonic: A town '阝' far off on the right — THAT one over there.
那.components: 𠮦 (form of 冉) + 阝 town (right side)

这儿.mnemonic: This '这' plus the little '儿' sound — right here.

那儿.mnemonic: That '那' plus the little '儿' sound — over there.

哪.mnemonic: A mouth '口' asking about that '那' — WHICH one?

哪儿.mnemonic: A mouth '口' asking about that '那' place plus '儿' — where?
哪儿.components: 哪 which (口 + 那) + 儿 (er suffix)

里.mnemonic: A farm field "田" sits on top of the earth "土": the seeds are inside the soil.
里.example_en: The cat is inside the house.

上.mnemonic: A short stroke pokes up above the long ground line, pointing to what is on top.
上.components: ⺊ mark pointing up + 一 ground line
上.example_en: The book is on the table.

下.mnemonic: A line hangs down beneath the flat ground stroke, pointing to what is below.
下.components: 一 ground line + 卜 mark hanging below
下.example_en: The dog is under the chair.

前面.mnemonic: Your face "面" always looks to the front "前", so what you see is in front of you.
前面.components: 前 front + 面 face; side

后面.mnemonic: The "后" back side "面" of you is what your face can never see: behind.
后面.components: 后 back; after + 面 face; side
后面.example_en: My cat is behind the door.

学校.mnemonic: A child "子" studies "学" under a roof, while crossed "交" wooden "木" beams build the school.
学校.components: 学 study (child 子 under a roof) + 校 school (木 wood + 交 cross)

医院.mnemonic: An arrow "矢" pulled out inside a box "匚" is treated in a walled courtyard "院": the hospital.
医院.components: 医 medicine (匚 box + 矢 arrow) + 院 courtyard (阝 + 完)
医院.example_en: My mom works at the hospital.

火车站.mnemonic: A fire "火" vehicle "车" (steam train) stops where people stand "立" waiting: the train station.
火车站.components: 火 fire + 车 vehicle + 站 station; stand (立 stand + 占)

住.mnemonic: A person "亻" who is master "主" of a house is someone who lives there.
住.components: 亻 person + 主 master; owner

去.mnemonic: A figure steps off the ground "土" with a bent leg "厶", heading away: to go.

来.mnemonic: It looks like a wheat plant "木" with extra ears of grain; the harvest has come.
来.components: originally a picture of a wheat plant; looks like 木 tree with two extra dots and a crossbar

回.mnemonic: A small box inside a big box "囗": you keep circling back home to the center.
回.components: 囗 enclosure inside a larger 囗 enclosure

看.mnemonic: A hand "手" shades the eye "目" to look far into the distance.
看.components: 龵 hand (from 手) + 目 eye

看见.mnemonic: Your hand shades your eye to look "看", and the eye on legs "见" finally sees.
看见.components: 看 look (hand 龵 + eye 目) + 见 see

听.mnemonic: A mouth "口" speaks sharp as an axe "斤", and you listen.
听.components: 口 mouth + 斤 axe (sound element)
听.example_en: I'm listening to the teacher speak.

说话.mnemonic: Speech "讠" plus a wagging tongue "舌" makes words "话": talking.
说话.components: 说 speak (讠 speech + 兑) + 话 words (讠 speech + 舌 tongue)

读.mnemonic: A market seller "卖" shouting words "讠" out loud is like reading aloud.

写.mnemonic: Under a cover "冖", a hooked brush stroke "与" glides across paper as you write.

做.mnemonic: A person "亻" with a cause "故" gets busy doing and making things.
做.components: 亻 person + 故 reason; old (古 + 攵 hand with stick)

工作.mnemonic: A carpenter's square "工" and a person "亻" doing "作" things: work.
工作.components: 工 work (a carpenter's tool) + 作 do; make (亻 person + 乍)

学习.mnemonic: A child "子" studies "学" under a roof, then practices "习" like a bird flapping its wing.
学习.components: 学 study (child 子 under a roof) + 习 practice (a wing)

睡觉.mnemonic: Your eye "目" droops "垂" shut and you stop seeing "见": time to sleep.
睡觉.components: 睡 sleep (目 eye + 垂 droop) + 觉 sleep; feel (⺍ + 冖 + 见 see)
睡觉.example_en: I go to bed at ten o'clock.

坐.mnemonic: Two people "人人" sit side by side on the ground "土".
坐.components: 人 person + 人 person + 土 earth; ground

开.mnemonic: Two hands "廾" lift the bar "一" off the gate to open it.
开.components: 一 bar + 廾 two hands

打电话.mnemonic: A hand "扌" taps "打" the electric "电" box to send words "话": make a phone call.
打电话.components: 打 hit (扌 hand + 丁 nail) + 电 electric + 话 words
打电话.example_en: I want to call my mom.

大.mnemonic: A person "人" stretches both arms wide "一" to show how big something is.
大.components: a person 人 with arms outstretched 一

小.mnemonic: A tiny hook with two little crumbs falling off each side: small.

多.mnemonic: Two evenings "夕" stacked up: many, many nights.
多.example_en: There are a lot of people here.

少.mnemonic: Something small "小" with a slice "丿" cut off becomes even fewer.
少.components: 小 small + 丿 slanted stroke
少.example_en: There are very few people at school today.

很.mnemonic: Taking a step "彳" that is really stubborn "艮": very determined.
很.components: 彳 step + 艮 (stubborn; sound element)

太.mnemonic: Big "大" plus an extra dot "丶": way too big.

热.mnemonic: Someone holds "执" a pot over four flames "灬": it's hot.

冷.mnemonic: Ice "冫" gives the order "令" to freeze: cold.

漂亮.mnemonic: Something floating on water "氵" gleams bright "亮" in the sun: beautiful.
漂亮.components: 漂 (氵 water + 票 ticket) + 亮 bright

高兴.mnemonic: Spirits rise "兴" as tall "高" as a tower: happy.
高兴.components: 高 tall (a tall tower) + 兴 rise; excitement

天气.mnemonic: The sky "天" fills with air and steam "气": the weather.
天气.components: 天 sky (一 + 大) + 气 air; steam

下雨.mnemonic: Raindrops under a cloud roof "雨" fall down "下": it's raining.
下雨.components: 下 down; fall + 雨 rain (drops under a sky cover)

书.mnemonic: A folded page with a spine down the middle and a dot bookmark: a book.
书.components: simplified from 書; 乛 folds + 丨 spine + 丶 dot

本.mnemonic: A tree "木" with a mark at its root: books come from the roots of trees.
本.components: 木 tree + 一 mark at the root

个.mnemonic: A single stick "丨" under a little roof "人": one item, counted.
个.components: 人 roof-shaped top + 丨 vertical stroke

电脑.mnemonic: An electric "电" brain "脑" sits on your desk: the computer.
电脑.components: 电 electric + 脑 brain (月 flesh + head-shaped part)
电脑.example_en: My computer is on the desk.

电视.mnemonic: An electric "电" box you look at "视" with your eyes: the television.
电视.components: 电 electric + 视 look (礻 + 见 see)

电影.mnemonic: Electric "电" shadows "影" dance on a big screen: a movie.
电影.components: 电 electric + 影 shadow; image (景 scene + 彡 streaks)

衣服.mnemonic: A collar and flowing robe "衣" worn on your body "月": clothes.
衣服.components: 衣 clothing (a robe with collar) + 服 clothes (月 body + 𠬝)
衣服.example_en: This piece of clothing is too big.

桌子.mnemonic: Wood "木" at the bottom holds up a flat top: a table.
桌子.components: 桌 table (top part + 木 wood) + 子 noun suffix
桌子.example_en: There is a cup on the table.

椅子.mnemonic: A strange "奇" wooden "木" thing with a back and four legs: a chair.
椅子.components: 椅 chair (木 wood + 奇 strange) + 子 noun suffix

字.mnemonic: A child "子" under a roof "宀" learns to write characters.
字.example_en: How do you read this character?

汉语.mnemonic: The Han "汉" people by the river "氵" use speech "讠" to say "I" "吾": the Chinese language.
汉语.components: 汉 Han Chinese (氵 water + 又) + 语 language (讠 speech + 吾 I)
汉语.example_en: I can speak a little Chinese.

猫.mnemonic: An animal "犭" hiding in the sprouts "苗" says "miao": the cat.
猫.components: 犭 animal + 苗 sprout (sound miáo)

狗.mnemonic: An animal "犭" that barks out sentences "句" all day: the dog.
狗.components: 犭 animal + 句 sentence (sound element)

飞机.mnemonic: A flying "飞" wing shape attached to a machine "机": an airplane.
飞机.components: 飞 fly (wing shape) + 机 machine (木 wood + 几 small table)

出租车.mnemonic: A vehicle "车" you rent "租" to go out "出": a taxi.
出租车.components: 出 go out + 租 rent (禾 grain + 且) + 车 vehicle

医生.mnemonic: The medicine "医" person who saves lives "生": the doctor.
医生.components: 医 medicine (匚 box + 矢 arrow) + 生 life; born

的.mnemonic: A white "白" ladle "勺" belongs to someone: it shows possession.

了.mnemonic: A hook "亅" hangs finished from a bent top "乛": the action is done.
了.components: 乛 bent stroke + 亅 hook

呢.mnemonic: A mouth "口" next to a nun "尼" gently asks, "And you?"
呢.components: 口 mouth + 尼 nun (sound element)

和.mnemonic: Grain "禾" and a mouth "口" go together, side by side: and, with.
和.example_en: My mom and I are going to the store.

都.mnemonic: Everyone "者" in the whole city "阝" is included: all.
都.components: 者 person; one who + 阝 city

有.mnemonic: A hand "𠂇" holding a piece of meat "月": to have.

没.mnemonic: A hand "又" reaches into the water "氵" and comes up with nothing: don't have.
没.components: 氵 water + 殳 (几 + 又 hand)

没关系.mnemonic: There is no "没" connection "关系" to any problem, so it doesn't matter.
没关系.components: 没 not + 关 concern; close + 系 connect

对不起.mnemonic: I couldn't "不" rise "起" to do it correctly "对": sorry.
对不起.components: 对 correct (又 + 寸) + 不 not + 起 rise (走 walk + 己)

会.mnemonic: A person under a roof "人" floats on clouds "云" because they know how to do it.
会.components: 人 roof-shaped top + 云 cloud

能.mnemonic: A strong bear with a head "厶", body "月" and paws "匕匕": it is able to do anything.
能.components: 厶 + 月 + 匕 + 匕 (originally a picture of a bear)

想.mnemonic: An eye "目" looks at a tree "木" and the heart "心" thinks and wishes.
想.components: 相 look at (木 tree + 目 eye) + 心 heart

喜欢.mnemonic: A drum and a singing mouth "喜" plus an open, yawning mouth "欠" of joy: to like.
喜欢.components: 喜 joy (壴 drum + 口 mouth) + 欢 joyful (又 hand + 欠 open mouth)

请.mnemonic: Fresh green "青" polite words "讠": please.
请.components: 讠 speech + 青 blue-green (sound element)

喂.mnemonic: A mouth "口" nervously "畏" says "wéi" into the phone: hello?
喂.components: 口 mouth + 畏 fear (sound element)

什么.mnemonic: A person "亻" counting to ten "十" scratches his head: what?
什么.components: 什 (亻 person + 十 ten) + 么 (question suffix)

谁.mnemonic: A little bird "隹" chirps a question "讠": who's there?
谁.components: 讠 speech + 隹 short-tailed bird

怎么.mnemonic: The heart "心" suddenly "乍" wonders: how?
怎么.components: 怎 (乍 suddenly + 心 heart) + 么 (question suffix)
怎么.example_en: How do I get to the train station?

怎么样.mnemonic: The heart asks how "怎么" the shape "样" of things is: how is it?
怎么样.components: 怎 how (乍 + 心 heart) + 么 suffix + 样 shape; kind (木 tree + 羊 sheep)

些.mnemonic: This "此" plus two "二" strokes: a few things, some.
些.example_en: I want to buy some fruit.

哥哥.mnemonic: "哥" is two "可" stacked: big brother stands tall, one head above you.
哥哥.components: 哥 = 可 stacked on 可 (older brother), doubled
哥哥.example_en: My older brother is twenty-five this year.

姐姐.mnemonic: "姐" is a woman "女" beside a sturdy stack "且": big sister who holds the family up.
姐姐.components: 姐 = 女 woman + 且 (sound), doubled
姐姐.example_en: My older sister works at a hospital.

弟弟.mnemonic: "弟" looks like a cord wound around a stick in order: little brother always comes next in line.
弟弟.components: 弟 = younger brother (old picture of a cord wound around a stake, meaning order), doubled
弟弟.example_en: My younger brother really likes playing football.

妹妹.mnemonic: "妹" is a woman "女" who is "未" not yet grown: your little sister.
妹妹.components: 妹 = 女 woman + 未 not yet, doubled
妹妹.example_en: My younger sister is still a student.

丈夫.mnemonic: "丈" a tall man and "夫" a grown man with a hairpin: the husband.
丈夫.components: 丈 elder man; ten-foot measure + 夫 man (大 with a hairpin line)

妻子.mnemonic: "妻" shows a hand pinning up a woman's hair "女": a married woman, the wife.
妻子.components: 妻 wife (hand 彐 holding a hairpin over 女 woman) + 子 noun suffix
妻子.example_en: His wife is a very good cook.

孩子.mnemonic: "孩" has "子" a baby with arms out, then "子" again: children everywhere!
孩子.components: 孩 = 子 child + 亥 (sound); 子 child/suffix

男.mnemonic: "男" is "力" strength working in the "田" field: the man ploughing.

女.mnemonic: "女" pictures a woman kneeling gracefully with crossed arms.
女.components: 女 pictograph of a kneeling woman
女.example_en: There are ten female students in our class.

大家.mnemonic: "大" a big crowd under one "家" roof: everyone in the house.
大家.components: 大 big + 家 home (宀 roof + 豕 pig)
大家.example_en: Hello everyone, my name is Wang Ming.

您.mnemonic: "您" puts "你" you above "心" heart: you, said with respect from the heart.

它.mnemonic: "它" looks like a snake coiled under a roof "宀": an animal, just "it".
它.components: 宀 roof + 匕 (originally a snake pictograph)
它.example_en: This is my cat; it is very cute.

服务员.mnemonic: Someone in work "服" clothes doing "务" tasks as a staff "员" member: the waiter.
服务员.components: 服 serve; clothes (月 + 𠬝) + 务 task (夂 + 力 strength) + 员 member (口 + 贝)
服务员.example_en: Waiter, we'd like two cups of tea.

姓.mnemonic: "姓" is "女" woman plus "生" birth: the name you get from the mother who bore you.
姓.components: 女 woman + 生 to be born

生日.mnemonic: The "日" day you were "生" born, like a sprout pushing out of the ground.
生日.components: 生 to be born (sprout from earth) + 日 sun; day

快乐.mnemonic: Your heart "忄" beats "快" fast with "乐" joy: happy!
快乐.components: 快 fast; pleased (忄 heart + 夬) + 乐 joy; music

早上.mnemonic: "早" shows the sun "日" rising just above a post "十": early morning.
早上.components: 早 early (日 sun over 十) + 上 on; upper part
早上.example_en: I get up at seven in the morning.

晚上.mnemonic: "晚" is the sun "日" excused "免" from duty: the evening.
晚上.components: 晚 late (日 sun + 免 to excuse) + 上 on; upper part
晚上.example_en: Let's go see a movie this evening.

起床.mnemonic: "起" yourself "己" walking "走" away from the wooden "床" bed: get up!
起床.components: 起 rise (走 walk + 己 self) + 床 bed (广 shelter + 木 wood)
起床.example_en: What time do you get up every day?

上班.mnemonic: Go "上" up to your "班" shift, where a knife "刂" splits two jade pieces "王" for the day's work.
上班.components: 上 up; go to + 班 shift; class (two 王 jade split by 刂 knife)
上班.example_zh: 我爸爸坐公共汽车上班。
上班.example_en: My dad takes the bus to work.

休息.mnemonic: "休" is a person "亻" leaning on a tree "木", breathing "息" from nose "自" and heart "心".
休息.components: 休 rest (亻 person + 木 tree) + 息 breath (自 nose + 心 heart)

洗.mnemonic: "洗" puts water "氵" first "先": wash before anything else.
洗.example_en: You should wash your hands before eating.

穿.mnemonic: "穿" is a tooth "牙" biting through a hole "穴": push through a sleeve to put it on.
穿.example_zh: 今天很冷，多穿点儿衣服。
穿.example_en: It's cold today; wear more clothes.

时间.mnemonic: The sun "日" seen through a door "门" marks the passing "时" time.
时间.components: 时 time (日 sun + 寸) + 间 interval (门 door + 日 sun)

小时.mnemonic: A "小" small piece of "时" time: one hour.
小时.components: 小 small + 时 time (日 sun + 寸)
小时.example_en: I study for two hours every day.

去年.mnemonic: The "年" year that has "去" gone away: last year.
去年.components: 去 to go; past + 年 year
去年.example_en: I went to Beijing last year.

号.mnemonic: "号" is a mouth "口" shouting out a number over a twisted line "丂".

已经.mnemonic: "已" a finished curl plus "经" silk threads "纟" already woven through.
已经.components: 已 already + 经 pass through (纟 silk + 𢀖)

正在.mnemonic: Standing "正" right "在" at the spot, doing it at this very moment.
正在.components: 正 just; straight (一 + 止 foot) + 在 at; in (contains 土 earth)

开始.mnemonic: Two hands "廾" lift a bar to "开" open, and a woman "女" on a platform "台" begins.
开始.components: 开 open (一 bar + 廾 two hands) + 始 begin (女 woman + 台)

完.mnemonic: "完" puts the origin "元" under a roof "宀": the house is complete, finished.
完.components: 宀 roof + 元 origin; first

准备.mnemonic: A bird "隹" on ice "冫" aims carefully, while feet "夂" stand over the field "田" ready.
准备.components: 准 accurate; allow (冫 ice + 隹 bird) + 备 prepare (夂 + 田 field)

咖啡.mnemonic: Two mouths "口" sound out "ka-fei": "加" add more and "非" never stop drinking coffee.
咖啡.components: 咖 = 口 mouth + 加 (sound); 啡 = 口 mouth + 非 (sound); sound loan of "coffee"
咖啡.example_en: I like to drink coffee in the morning.

牛奶.mnemonic: The cow "牛" gives what a woman "女" gives her baby: milk "奶".
牛奶.components: 牛 cow + 奶 milk (女 woman + 乃)
牛奶.example_en: The child drinks milk every day.

鸡蛋.mnemonic: A hand "又" grabs the bird "鸟" chicken, and its creature "虫" egg "蛋" falls out.
鸡蛋.components: 鸡 chicken (又 + 鸟 bird) + 蛋 egg (疋 + 虫 creature)
鸡蛋.example_en: I ate two eggs this morning.

面条.mnemonic: Flour "面" rolled into long branches "条" like tree "木" twigs: noodles.
面条.components: 面 face; flour + 条 strip (夂 + 木 tree)
面条.example_en: I want to eat noodles tonight.

羊肉.mnemonic: A sheep "羊" with horns on top, and "肉" meat with ribs inside: lamb.
羊肉.components: 羊 sheep (horns on top) + 肉 meat
羊肉.example_zh: 这家饭馆的羊肉很好吃。
羊肉.example_en: The lamb at this restaurant is delicious.

鱼.mnemonic: "鱼" is a fish: pointed head on top, scaly "田" body, tail line at the bottom.
鱼.components: 鱼 pictograph: head ⺈ + body 田 + tail 一

西瓜.mnemonic: A "瓜" melon hanging on its vine, brought from the "西" west: watermelon.
西瓜.components: 西 west + 瓜 melon (pictograph of a melon on a vine)
西瓜.example_en: Eating watermelon in summer is great!

好吃.mnemonic: Good "好" (woman "女" with child "子") for the mouth "口" to eat "吃": tasty!
好吃.components: 好 good (女 woman + 子 child) + 吃 eat (口 mouth + 乞)
好吃.example_en: The food Mom makes is delicious.

卖.mnemonic: "卖" is "买" buy with a "十" on top: what you buy, the seller adds a plus and sells.

贵.mnemonic: Piles of shells "贝", ancient money, stacked high: it is expensive.
贵.example_en: This piece of clothing is too expensive!

便宜.mnemonic: A person "亻" changes "更" the price, and it fits under your roof "宀": cheap!
便宜.components: 便 convenient (亻 person + 更 change) + 宜 suitable (宀 roof + 且)
便宜.example_en: The fruit here is very cheap.

千.mnemonic: "千" is "十" ten with a slash on top, multiplying it up to a thousand.
千.example_en: This phone costs three thousand yuan.

百.mnemonic: "百" is one "一" over white "白": one bright hundred.
百.example_zh: 我们学校有五百个学生。
百.example_en: Our school has five hundred students.

两.mnemonic: "两" shows two people "人" inside one frame, side by side: two.
两.components: 一 + 冂 frame with two 人 inside (originally a yoke)
两.example_en: I'd like two cups of coffee.

身体.mnemonic: "身" a pictured body and "体" a person "亻" with roots "本": your body and health.
身体.components: 身 body (pictograph of a person's torso) + 体 body (亻 person + 本 root)

眼睛.mnemonic: Two eyes "目" side by side, the second clear and bright "青".
眼睛.components: 眼 eye (目 eye + 艮) + 睛 eyeball (目 eye + 青 clear; blue-green)
眼睛.example_en: Her eyes are big and beautiful.

生病.mnemonic: Something is "生" born under the sickbed roof "疒": you get sick.
生病.components: 生 to produce; be born + 病 illness (疒 sickness + 丙)
生病.example_zh: 他生病了，今天没去上班。
生病.example_en: He got sick and didn't go to work today.

药.mnemonic: Grass "艹" bundled "约" with silk thread: herbal medicine.
药.components: 艹 grass + 约 (纟 silk + 勺)

累.mnemonic: Working the field "田" and spinning silk "糸" all day leaves you tired.
累.components: 田 field + 糸 silk thread
累.example_en: I had too much work today; I'm very tired.

运动.mnemonic: Clouds "云" moving "辶" along, and clouds pushed by strength "力": exercise!
运动.components: 运 move; transport (辶 walk + 云 cloud) + 动 move (云 cloud + 力 strength)

跑步.mnemonic: A foot "⻊" wrapped "包" in motion, taking "步" step after step: jogging.
跑步.components: 跑 run (⻊ foot + 包 wrap) + 步 step (止 foot over another foot)
跑步.example_zh: 我们晚上一起去跑步吧。
跑步.example_en: Let's go jogging together this evening.

游泳.mnemonic: Water "氵" on both sides: you swim "游" through it "永" forever.
游泳.components: 游 swim; tour (氵 water + 斿) + 泳 swim (氵 water + 永 forever)

踢足球.mnemonic: A foot "⻊" kicks "踢" with the foot "足" a jade "王" ball "球".
踢足球.components: 踢 kick (⻊ foot + 易) + 足 foot + 球 ball (王 jade + 求)
踢足球.example_en: We're going to play football this afternoon.

打篮球.mnemonic: A hand "扌" hits "打" a ball "球" into a bamboo "⺮" basket "篮".
打篮球.components: 打 hit (扌 hand + 丁 nail) + 篮 basket (⺮ bamboo + 监) + 球 ball (王 + 求)

跳舞.mnemonic: Feet "⻊" jump "跳" while the dancer "舞" swings feet "舛" below.
跳舞.components: 跳 jump (⻊ foot + 兆) + 舞 dance (dancer figure with 舛 two feet at bottom)

唱歌.mnemonic: A mouth "口" sings bright "昌", and big brother "哥" opens wide "欠" in song.
唱歌.components: 唱 sing (口 mouth + 昌 bright) + 歌 song (哥 + 欠 open mouth)

玩.mnemonic: "玩" is playing with jade "王" toys from the very first "元" day: have fun!
玩.components: 王 jade + 元 first; origin

笑.mnemonic: Bamboo "⺮" leaves bend over a swaying person "夭" laughing so hard.

旅游.mnemonic: People follow a flag "方" on a journey "旅" and swim "游" around: tourism.
旅游.components: 旅 travel (方 + flag + people) + 游 tour; swim (氵 water + 斿)
旅游.example_en: I want to travel to China.

机场.mnemonic: Machines "机" of wood "木" and a table "几" landing on the ground "土" field "场": airport.
机场.components: 机 machine (木 wood + 几 small table) + 场 open field (土 earth + 𠃓)
机场.example_en: I'm taking a taxi to the airport.

公共汽车.mnemonic: A "公" public "共" shared "汽" steam-powered "车" vehicle: the bus.
公共汽车.components: 公 public (八 + 厶) + 共 together + 汽 steam (氵 water + 气 air) + 车 vehicle
公共汽车.example_zh: 我每天坐公共汽车去学校。
公共汽车.example_en: I take the bus to school every day.

自行车.mnemonic: A "车" vehicle that "行" goes by "自" itself, with your legs: bicycle.
自行车.components: 自 self (nose pictograph) + 行 go (crossroads) + 车 vehicle (cart pictograph)
自行车.example_en: He rides a bicycle to work.

宾馆.mnemonic: A guest "宾" under a roof "宀" and a building with food "饣": a hotel.
宾馆.components: 宾 guest (宀 roof + 兵) + 馆 building; hall (饣 food + 官)
宾馆.example_zh: 我们住在机场旁边的宾馆。
宾馆.example_en: We're staying at a hotel next to the airport.

房间.mnemonic: A door "户" and a gate "门" with sun "日" inside: your room.
房间.components: 房 house (户 door + 方) + 间 space (门 door + 日 sun)

票.mnemonic: "票" is a slip shown "示" under a cover "覀": your ticket.

路.mnemonic: Each "各" foot "⻊" walks its own road.
路.example_en: I saw him on the road.

走.mnemonic: "走" shows earth "土" above a striding foot: walk away!
走.components: 土 + a foot shape (止 variant)

到.mnemonic: "到" is arriving "至" with a knife "刂" at your side: you reached the place.
到.components: 至 to arrive + 刂 knife

进.mnemonic: Walk "辶" toward the well "井" and step into the village: enter.
进.example_en: Please come in and sit down.

出.mnemonic: "出" looks like a mountain "山" on a mountain "山": climb out and exit.
出.components: looks like 山 on 山 (originally a foot stepping out of a pit)
出.example_en: He went out to buy things.

门.mnemonic: "门" pictures a doorway with a little handle at top left.
门.components: 门 pictograph of a door (simplified from 門 double doors)

欢迎.mnemonic: An open mouth "欠" cheers "欢" while you walk "辶" to meet "迎" the guest.
欢迎.components: 欢 joyful (又 hand + 欠 open mouth) + 迎 meet (卬 + 辶 walk)

快.mnemonic: Your heart "忄" races "快" fast when you snap "夬" into action.

万.mnemonic: A single line '一' with a swooping hook beneath counts ten thousand ants marching underneath.
万.components: 一 one + 𠃌 hooked stroke (simplified from 萬, originally a scorpion)
万.example_en: This city has thirty thousand people.

半.mnemonic: A vertical stroke '丨' slices straight through the middle, cutting everything into two halves.
半.components: 丷 two dots + 二 two lines + 丨 vertical stroke cutting through the middle
半.example_en: I waited for you for half an hour.

刻.mnemonic: A knife '刂' carves a notch in a clock every quarter hour.
刻.example_en: It's a quarter past three now.

公斤.mnemonic: Public '公' scales weigh meat chopped with an axe '斤' in kilograms.
公斤.components: 公 public (八 + 厶) + 斤 axe; a unit of weight
公斤.example_en: These apples weigh two kilograms in total.

米.mnemonic: Rice grains scattered around a cross '十' are laid end to end to measure a meter.
米.components: 米 pictograph of rice grains around a cross; also borrowed for meter
米.example_en: This road is one hundred meters long.

一共.mnemonic: One '一' big group of hands holding things together '共' gives the total.
一共.components: 一 one + 共 together (hands holding up an object)
一共.example_en: There are five of us altogether.

差.mnemonic: A sheep '羊' that won't work '工' falls short and does a poor job.
差.components: 𦍌 sheep (without its tail stroke) + 工 work
差.example_en: It's five minutes to eight now.

双.mnemonic: Two right hands '又又' side by side make a pair.
双.components: 又 hand + 又 hand (simplified from 雙, two birds in a hand)
双.example_en: I bought a new pair of shoes.

张.mnemonic: Pull a bow '弓' long '长' and it stretches flat like a sheet of paper.
张.example_en: Please give me a sheet of paper.

条.mnemonic: A long branch hangs from a tree '木' trailing behind '夂' like a long thin strip.
条.components: 夂 walking slowly + 木 tree
条.example_en: There is a big fish in the river.

辆.mnemonic: A vehicle '车' with two '两' axles is counted one by one.
辆.components: 车 vehicle + 两 two (sound component)
辆.example_zh: 门口停着一辆红色的车。
辆.example_en: A red car is parked at the door.

位.mnemonic: A person '亻' standing '立' in their place deserves polite respect.

段.mnemonic: A hand holding a tool '殳' chops a long thing into sections.
段.components: left component (steps/cliff) + 殳 hand holding a tool
段.example_en: I've been very busy during this period.

口.mnemonic: '口' is a wide-open square mouth; count family members by mouths to feed.
口.components: 口 pictograph of an open mouth
口.example_en: There are three people in my family.

种.mnemonic: Sort grain '禾' right down the middle '中' into different kinds.
种.components: 禾 grain + 中 middle (sound component)
种.example_en: What kind of fruit do you like?

刚才.mnemonic: A knife '刂' sliced the ridge just a moment ago, and a sprout '才' just appeared.
刚才.components: 刚 just (冈 ridge + 刂 knife) + 才 just; only (sprout pictograph)
刚才.example_en: Where did you go just now?

以前.mnemonic: Using '以' the front '前' of the timeline, you look back to before.
以前.components: 以 by; with + 前 front; before
以前.example_en: I had never been to Beijing before.

过去.mnemonic: Walk '辶' past and go '去' away, and it becomes the past.
过去.components: 过 pass (辶 walk + 寸) + 去 go (土 + 厶)
过去.example_en: Don't think about things in the past.

后来.mnemonic: What comes '来' behind '后' is what happens afterwards.
后来.components: 后 behind; after + 来 come

最近.mnemonic: Take '取' the most '最' recent days, the ones walking '辶' nearest you '近'.
最近.components: 最 most (曰 + 取 take) + 近 near (辶 walk + 斤 axe)

马上.mnemonic: Jump on '上' a horse '马' and gallop off immediately.
马上.components: 马 horse + 上 on; up
马上.example_en: Wait a second, I'm coming right away!

一会儿.mnemonic: One '一' quick meeting '会' with a child '儿' only lasts a moment.
一会儿.components: 一 one + 会 meet; moment (人 + 云) + 儿 child; -r suffix

久.mnemonic: '久' looks like a person dragging something behind for a long, long time.
久.components: 久 pictograph of a person with something dragging behind

经常.mnemonic: Silk '纟' threads woven on cloth '巾' every day, again and again, often.
经常.components: 经 pass through (纟 silk + 𢀖) + 常 constant (尚 + 巾 cloth)
经常.example_en: I often go to the library to read.

总是.mnemonic: Every heart '心' under the sun '日' is always right '是'.
总是.components: 总 always; total (丷 + 口 + 心 heart) + 是 is; right (日 sun + 𤴓)
总是.example_en: He always goes to bed very late.

一直.mnemonic: An eye '目' looks straight '直' ahead the whole time, all along.
一直.components: 一 one + 直 straight (十 + 目 eye + bottom stroke)
一直.example_en: Go straight ahead and you'll get there.

终于.mnemonic: Silk '纟' threads run out in winter '冬', at the year's end; finally!
终于.components: 终 end (纟 silk + 冬 winter) + 于 at
终于.example_zh: 我终于找到我的手机了！

突然.mnemonic: A dog '犬' bursts out of a hole '穴' suddenly, like fire '灬' flaring up.
突然.components: 突 dash out (穴 hole + 犬 dog) + 然 so; -ly (肰 + 灬 fire)

先.mnemonic: A foot steps out in front of the legs '儿', going first.
先.example_zh: 你先吃饭，我等一会儿再吃。
先.example_en: You eat first; I'll eat in a while.

然后.mnemonic: So '然' after '后' that, this happens next: then.
然后.components: 然 so; like that + 后 after
然后.example_en: I wash my hands first, then eat.

试.mnemonic: Speak '讠' a formula '式' out loud to try it out.
试.components: 讠 speech + 式 formula; style
试.example_zh: 这件衣服我可以试一下吗？
试.example_en: Can I try on this piece of clothing?

哭.mnemonic: Two wailing mouths '口口' on top of a dog '犬' crying and howling.
哭.components: 吅 two mouths + 犬 dog

同意.mnemonic: Two hearts '心' with the same '同' idea '意' agree.
同意.components: 同 same (冂 + 一 + 口) + 意 idea (音 sound + 心 heart)
同意.example_en: Mom agreed to let me go traveling.

选择.mnemonic: Walk '辶' up first '先', then pick with your hand '扌' to choose.
选择.components: 选 select (辶 walk + 先 first) + 择 pick (扌 hand + 㚇)
选择.example_en: Which of these two do you choose?

注意.mnemonic: Pour '注' water '氵' over your idea '意' to focus attention on it.
注意.components: 注 pour; focus (氵 water + 主 master) + 意 idea (音 + 心 heart)
注意.example_zh: 过马路的时候要注意车。
注意.example_en: Watch out for cars when crossing the road.

影响.mnemonic: A shadow '影' and an echo '响' from a mouth '口' spread their influence.
影响.components: 影 shadow (景 scene + 彡 rays) + 响 sound (口 mouth + 向 toward)
影响.example_zh: 玩手机会影响你的学习。
影响.example_en: Playing on your phone will affect your studies.

作用.mnemonic: A person '亻' at work '作' puts a tool to use '用': that's its function.
作用.components: 作 do; make (亻 person + 乍) + 用 use
作用.example_en: This medicine doesn't have much effect.

关系.mnemonic: A closed gate '关' tied with silk threads '糸' links people in a relationship.
关系.components: 关 close; relate (丷 + 天) + 系 tie (丿 + 糸 silk)
关系.example_zh: 我们两个人的关系很好。
关系.example_en: The two of us have a very good relationship.

发.mnemonic: An arrow flies off a bow, sent out with a swoosh; '发' means send.
发.components: 发 simplified from 發 (弓 bow + 癶 feet), to shoot off
发.example_zh: 我给你发了一个电子邮件。

起来.mnemonic: Walk '走' yourself '己' up off the bed and come '来' get up.
起来.components: 起 rise (走 walk + 己 self) + 来 come
起来.example_en: Get up quickly, you're going to be late!

应该.mnemonic: Under the shelter '广' you should speak '讠' properly; that's what you ought to do.
应该.components: 应 should (广 shelter + inner strokes; simplified from 應 with 心 heart) + 该 ought (讠 speech + 亥)

必须.mnemonic: A heart '心' slashed by a stroke '丿' must be fixed; a beard '须' must grow.
必须.components: 必 must (心 heart + 丿 slash) + 须 must; beard (彡 hair + 页 head)
必须.example_en: You must come a bit earlier tomorrow.

几乎.mnemonic: A tiny table '几' barely holding a wobbly '乎' sound almost falls.
几乎.components: 几 small table; few + 乎 particle

一定.mnemonic: Under one '一' roof '宀', everything is settled for sure: definitely.
一定.components: 一 one + 定 settle (宀 roof + 𤴓 correct)

比较.mnemonic: Two people '匕匕' compare their cars '车' side by side.
比较.components: 比 compare (two figures 匕 side by side) + 较 compare (车 vehicle + 交 exchange)

更.mnemonic: An extra stroke over the sun '日' makes the day even more bright.
更.components: 更 一 + 曰/日 + crossing strokes
更.example_en: This one is even better than that one.

特别.mnemonic: A special bull '牛' at the temple '寺' is set apart by a knife '刂'.
特别.components: 特 special (牛 ox + 寺 temple) + 别 separate (另 + 刂 knife)
特别.example_en: The food here is especially delicious.

极.mnemonic: Climb the tree '木' until you reach '及' the extreme top.

多么.mnemonic: Many '多' evenings '夕夕' make a tiny '么' sigh: how wonderful!
多么.components: 多 many (夕 + 夕 evenings) + 么 suffix (丿 + 厶)
多么.example_en: How beautiful the scenery here is!

当然.mnemonic: A hand '彐' under small dots '⺌' deals with it as it should be, so '然', of course.
当然.components: 当 should; serve as (⺌ + 彐 hand) + 然 so; like that

又.mnemonic: '又' is a right hand reaching out again and again.
又.components: 又 pictograph of a right hand

只.mnemonic: A mouth '口' with only two little legs '八' under it: just that.
只.components: 口 mouth + 八 two strokes below

一般.mnemonic: One '一' ordinary boat '舟' rowed with a pole '殳', just general stuff.
一般.components: 一 one + 般 kind; sort (舟 boat + 殳 hand with tool)
一般.example_en: I generally get up at seven.

主要.mnemonic: A lamp's flame '丶' above the king '王' is what the woman '女' wants most: main.
主要.components: 主 master (丶 flame + 王) + 要 want; important (覀 + 女 woman)
主要.example_zh: 我来这里主要是为了学汉语。
主要.example_en: I came here mainly to study Chinese.

一边.mnemonic: Walk '辶' with strength '力' on one '一' side while doing another thing.
一边.components: 一 one + 边 side (辶 walk + 力 strength)
一边.example_zh: 他一边吃饭一边看电视。

越.mnemonic: Walk '走' with a battle-axe '戉' and the more you go, the farther you surpass.
越.example_en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier.

还是.mnemonic: Walk '辶' back '还' and still pick what is right '是': this or that?
还是.components: 还 still; return (辶 walk + 不) + 是 is; right
还是.example_en: Would you like tea or coffee?

地.mnemonic: Earth '土' also '也' grounds the action, turning a word into an adverb.

啊.mnemonic: An open mouth '口' says 'ah!' next to a hill '阝' that can '可' echo.
啊.components: 口 mouth + 阿 (阝 hill + 可 can)

把.mnemonic: A hand '扌' grabs a snake '巴' and holds it firmly.
把.components: 扌 hand + 巴 (sound component; snake pictograph)

被.mnemonic: Clothing '衤' made of skin '皮' is a blanket you are covered by.
被.example_en: My cake was eaten by my little brother.

跟.mnemonic: Your foot '𧾷' follows right on someone's heels '艮'.

为.mnemonic: Two drops '丶' of sweat on a strong arm '力' working for someone.
为.components: 丶 + 力-like shape + 丶 (simplified from 為)
为.example_zh: 我为你准备了一个礼物。
为.example_en: I prepared a gift for you.

为了.mnemonic: For '为' a goal, everything is finished '了': in order to.
为了.components: 为 for + 了 finished; particle
为了.example_zh: 为了身体健康，他每天跑步。
为了.example_en: He runs every day for the sake of his health.

关于.mnemonic: A closed gate '关' at '于' the topic, keeping everything about it.
关于.components: 关 close; relate + 于 at; regarding
关于.example_zh: 这是一本关于中国历史的书。
关于.example_en: This is a book about Chinese history.

根据.mnemonic: Tree roots '根' in the hand '扌' that dwells '居' on firm ground: the basis.
根据.components: 根 root (木 tree + 艮) + 据 base on (扌 hand + 居 reside)
根据.example_zh: 根据天气预报，明天会下雨。
根据.example_en: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

除了.mnemonic: Remove the leftovers '余' from the hill '阝' and it's finished '了': except that.
除了.components: 除 remove (阝 hill + 余 remainder) + 了 particle

如果.mnemonic: If a woman's '女' mouth '口' says so, fruit '果' grows on the tree '木'.
如果.components: 如 if; like (女 woman + 口 mouth) + 果 fruit (田 + 木 tree)
如果.example_zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
如果.example_en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

或者.mnemonic: A guard with a spear '戈' chooses this person '者' or that one.
或者.components: 或 or (戈 spear + 口 + 一) + 者 person (耂 + 日)
或者.example_zh: 你可以坐公共汽车或者打车去。
或者.example_en: You can go by bus or take a taxi.

不但.mnemonic: Not '不' only the person '亻' at dawn '旦' but more.
不但.components: 不 not + 但 but (亻 person + 旦 dawn)
不但.example_zh: 她不但漂亮，而且很聪明。
不但.example_en: She is not only pretty but also very smart.

而且.mnemonic: A beard '而' and a stacked pile '且' too: moreover.
而且.components: 而 and; but (beard pictograph) + 且 moreover (stacked-object pictograph)
而且.example_zh: 这家饭馆的菜很便宜，而且很好吃。
而且.example_en: This restaurant's food is cheap, and moreover it's delicious.

其他.mnemonic: Its '其' basket belongs to that other person '他' (亻 + 也).
其他.components: 其 its; that (winnowing basket pictograph) + 他 he; other (亻 person + 也)
其他.example_en: The other classmates have all gone home.

阿姨.mnemonic: A woman "女" in "姨" lives by the hill "阝" next door: your friendly auntie.
阿姨.components: 阿: 阝 mound + 可 can (prefix); 姨: 女 woman + 夷 (phonetic)
阿姨.example_zh: 阿姨每天早上都去公园跑步。
阿姨.example_en: Auntie goes running in the park every morning.

叔叔.mnemonic: Two "叔" each lift a hand "又" to wave: uncle greeting you twice.
叔叔.components: 叔: 尗 (phonetic) + 又 hand; repeated as 叔叔 uncle

爷爷.mnemonic: "爷" has father "父" on top: father of your father, grandpa, said twice with love.
爷爷.components: 爷: 父 father + 卩 kneeling figure; repeated as 爷爷 grandpa
爷爷.example_zh: 爷爷喜欢在家里看报纸。
爷爷.example_en: Grandpa likes reading the newspaper at home.

奶奶.mnemonic: A woman "女" beside "乃" twice: grandma, the woman who nurtured the family.
奶奶.components: 奶: 女 woman + 乃 (phonetic); repeated as 奶奶 grandma
奶奶.example_en: The food Grandma cooks is especially delicious.

邻居.mnemonic: "邻" has the town "阝" and "居" a house: people living in your town beside you.
邻居.components: 邻: 令 order (phonetic) + 阝 city; 居: 尸 body/roof + 古 old — to reside
邻居.example_en: My neighbor is very warm and friendly.

客人.mnemonic: "客" shows each one "各" arriving under your roof "宀": a person visiting, a guest.
客人.components: 客: 宀 roof + 各 each; 人: person
客人.example_en: We have guests at home tonight.

同事.mnemonic: "同" means same, "事" means work: people doing the same work are colleagues.
同事.components: 同: same (冂 frame + 一 + 口); 事: matter, work
同事.example_zh: 我和同事一起去吃午饭。
同事.example_en: I went to lunch with my colleagues.

经理.mnemonic: "经" silk threads "纟" and "理" jade "王" polished in order: a manager keeps everything orderly.
经理.components: 经: 纟 silk + 𢀖 (simplified 巠) — to manage, pass through; 理: 王 jade + 里 (phonetic) — to put in order
经理.example_en: The manager isn't in the office today.

校长.mnemonic: "校" has a tree "木" by the school; "长" the chief: the head of the school.
校长.components: 校: 木 tree + 交 (phonetic) — school; 长: chief, head
校长.example_zh: 校长在会上讲了很多话。
校长.example_en: The principal spoke a lot at the meeting.

司机.mnemonic: "司" a mouth "口" giving orders, "机" a wooden "木" machine: the one commanding the machine, a driver.
司机.components: 司: to manage (𠃌 + 一 + 口); 机: 木 wood + 几 (phonetic) — machine
司机.example_zh: 出租车司机知道去机场的路。
司机.example_en: The taxi driver knows the way to the airport.

别人.mnemonic: "别" has a knife "刂" cutting off; "人" person: people cut off from you, others.
别人.components: 别: 另 another + 刂 knife — separate, other; 人: person
别人.example_en: Don't always listen to what other people say.

自己.mnemonic: "自" is a nose (point at your nose to say me) plus "己" self: oneself.
自己.components: 自: self (pictograph of a nose); 己: self
自己.example_en: You have to do this yourself.

结婚.mnemonic: Tie a silk knot "纟" with a woman "女" at dusk "昏": the wedding knot.
结婚.components: 结: 纟 silk + 吉 lucky — to tie; 婚: 女 woman + 昏 dusk — marriage
结婚.example_en: My older brother is getting married next year.

年轻.mnemonic: Few years "年" and a light "轻" cart "车": light in years, young.
年轻.components: 年: year; 轻: 车 vehicle + 𢀖 (phonetic) — light

老.mnemonic: An old person with long hair "耂" leaning on a bent cane "匕".
老.components: 老: 耂 old-person top + 匕 (bent figure/cane)
老.example_zh: 我的电脑太老了，常常坏。
老.example_en: My computer is too old; it often breaks down.

鼻子.mnemonic: "鼻" starts with "自", a nose pictograph sitting on a field "田": your nose.
鼻子.components: 鼻: 自 nose + 田 + 丌; 子: noun suffix

耳朵.mnemonic: "耳" looks like an ear, and "朵" a flower on a tree "木": ears blooming on your head.
耳朵.components: 耳: ear (pictograph); 朵: 几 + 木 tree — bloom, measure word

脸.mnemonic: Flesh "月" where everything "佥" gathers: eyes, nose and mouth together on your face.
脸.components: 脸: 月 flesh + 佥 all together (phonetic)
脸.example_en: Why is your face so red?

脚.mnemonic: Flesh "月" plus "却" step back: the body part that steps, your foot.
脚.components: 脚: 月 flesh + 却 (去 go + 卩)
脚.example_en: I walked all day and my feet are tired.

腿.mnemonic: Flesh "月" plus "退" retreat: the limb that walks you backward, the leg.
腿.components: 腿: 月 flesh + 退 retreat (phonetic)
腿.example_en: He has long legs and runs very fast.

头发.mnemonic: "头" head plus "发" hair: the hair growing on your head.
头发.components: 头: head; 发: hair (simplified from 髮)
头发.example_en: Her hair is black and long.

个子.mnemonic: "个" looks like a person standing tall with arms out: your height.
个子.components: 个: measure word (a standing figure shape); 子: noun suffix
个子.example_en: My younger brother is very tall.

健康.mnemonic: A person "亻" who builds "建" strength under a sheltering roof "广": healthy.
健康.components: 健: 亻 person + 建 build — strong; 康: 广 shelter + lower part — well-being
健康.example_zh: 多运动对身体健康有好处。
健康.example_en: Exercising more is good for your health.

感冒.mnemonic: "感" feel in the heart "心", "冒" a hat over eyes "目": feeling foggy with a cold.
感冒.components: 感: 咸 + 心 heart — feel; 冒: 曰 covering + 目 eye — to emit, risk
感冒.example_en: It's getting cold, be careful not to catch a cold.

发烧.mnemonic: "发" send out and "烧" with fire "火": your body sends out fire, a fever.
发烧.components: 发: to emit; 烧: 火 fire + 尧 (phonetic) — to burn
发烧.example_en: The child has a fever and needs to go to the hospital.

疼.mnemonic: Under the sickbed roof "疒" in winter "冬": aching, painful.
疼.components: 疼: 疒 sickness + 冬 winter (phonetic)
疼.example_en: I have a headache and want to rest a bit.

检查.mnemonic: Gather all "佥" by the tree "木" and look at it at dawn "旦": to check carefully.
检查.components: 检: 木 wood + 佥 all — inspect; 查: 木 wood + 旦 dawn — examine
检查.example_en: The doctor gave me a physical examination.

锻炼.mnemonic: Hammer metal "钅" and heat it in fire "火": forge your body by exercising.
锻炼.components: 锻: 钅 metal + 段 section (phonetic) — forge; 炼: 火 fire + simplified 柬 (phonetic) — refine
锻炼.example_zh: 我每天晚上都去锻炼身体。
锻炼.example_en: I go to work out every evening.

刷牙.mnemonic: "刷" a cloth "巾" and blade "刂" scrubbing, "牙" a tooth: brush your teeth.
刷牙.components: 刷: 尸 + 巾 cloth + 刂 knife — to brush; 牙: tooth
刷牙.example_en: You must brush your teeth before going to bed.

洗澡.mnemonic: Water "氵" twice, with birds chirping "品" in a tree "木": splashing in the bath.
洗澡.components: 洗: 氵 water + 先 first — wash; 澡: 氵 water + 喿 (品 over 木, phonetic) — bathe
洗澡.example_en: I take a shower every night.

舒服.mnemonic: "舒" stretch out at home "舍", "服" clothes on your body "月": stretched and dressed comfortably.
舒服.components: 舒: 舍 house + 予 give — stretch, relax; 服: 月 body + 𠬝 — clothes, serve
舒服.example_en: This chair is very comfortable to sit in.

矮.mnemonic: An arrow "矢" is short, next to a bent-over "委" figure: short in height.
矮.components: 矮: 矢 arrow + 委 bend/yield (phonetic)
矮.example_en: I'm a little shorter than my younger sister.

胖.mnemonic: Flesh "月" with an extra half "半" more: fat, chubby.
胖.components: 胖: 月 flesh + 半 half
胖.example_en: This cat is too fat to run.

瘦.mnemonic: A sick "疒" old man "叟" who has lost weight: thin.
瘦.components: 瘦: 疒 sickness + 叟 old man
瘦.example_en: She has lost a lot of weight recently.

短.mnemonic: An arrow "矢" next to a small bean "豆": short things.
短.components: 短: 矢 arrow + 豆 bean

可爱.mnemonic: "可" can and "爱" love: something you can't help but love, cute.
可爱.components: 可: can, may; 爱: love (爫 hand + 冖 cover + 友 friend)

干净.mnemonic: "干" dry and "净" ice "冫" pure: dry and pure, clean.
干净.components: 干: dry; 净: 冫 ice + 争 (phonetic) — pure
干净.example_en: The room has been cleaned very well.

旧.mnemonic: A stick "丨" beside an old sun "日" that has risen many days: old, used.
旧.example_zh: 我的手机很旧了，想买个新的。
旧.example_en: My phone is old; I want to buy a new one.

坏.mnemonic: Earth "土" that is not "不" good: bad, broken ground.
坏.components: 坏: 土 earth + 不 not

新鲜.mnemonic: "新" freshly cut with an axe "斤", "鲜" fish "鱼" and lamb "羊": fresh food.
新鲜.components: 新: 亲-like left + 斤 axe — new; 鲜: 鱼 fish + 羊 sheep — fresh

简单.mnemonic: "简" bamboo "⺮" slips and "单" single: just one bamboo note, simple.
简单.components: 简: ⺮ bamboo + 间 between — simple; 单: single

容易.mnemonic: A valley "谷" under a roof "宀" holds anything; sun "日" changes easily: easy.
容易.components: 容: 宀 roof + 谷 valley — contain; 易: 日 sun + 勿 — change, easy
容易.example_en: Learning to write Chinese characters isn't very easy.

难.mnemonic: A hand "又" trying to grab a bird "隹": hard, difficult.
难.components: 难: 又 hand + 隹 short-tailed bird

奇怪.mnemonic: A big "大" "可" and a heart "忄" puzzled: something strange.
奇怪.components: 奇: 大 big + 可 can — odd; 怪: 忄 heart + 圣 — strange
奇怪.example_en: Why is he acting so strangely today?

一样.mnemonic: "一" one "样" pattern, a tree "木" and sheep "羊" all the same: alike.
一样.components: 一: one; 样: 木 tree + 羊 sheep (phonetic) — appearance, pattern
一样.example_en: My older sister and I are the same height.

像.mnemonic: A person "亻" standing beside an elephant "象", copying its pose: to resemble.
像.components: 像: 亻 person + 象 elephant/image
像.example_en: You look a lot like your mother.

有名.mnemonic: "有" have a "名" name, called out by mouth "口" at night "夕": famous.
有名.components: 有: to have; 名: 夕 evening + 口 mouth — name

安静.mnemonic: A woman "女" under a roof "宀" at peace, calm blue "青": quiet.
安静.components: 安: 宀 roof + 女 woman — peaceful; 静: 青 blue/green + 争 — still
安静.example_en: It's very quiet in the library.

聪明.mnemonic: Sharp ears "耳" and a bright sun "日" and moon "月": clever.
聪明.components: 聪: 耳 ear + 总 (phonetic) — keen hearing; 明: 日 sun + 月 moon — bright

热情.mnemonic: Fire dots "灬" under feelings from the heart "忄": warm and enthusiastic.
热情.components: 热: 执 + 灬 fire — hot; 情: 忄 heart + 青 (phonetic) — feeling
热情.example_en: The people here are all very warm.

认真.mnemonic: Words "讠" from a person "人" that are true "真": serious, conscientious.
认真.components: 认: 讠 speech + 人 person — recognize; 真: true, real

努力.mnemonic: A servant "奴" using all his strength "力": working hard.
努力.components: 努: 奴 slave/servant + 力 strength; 力: strength (a plow/arm)
努力.example_en: As long as you work hard, you can succeed.

满意.mnemonic: Water "氵" filled to the brim, and the heart's "心" wish fulfilled: satisfied.
满意.components: 满: 氵 water + 㒼 — full; 意: 音 sound + 心 heart — intention, wish
满意.example_zh: 老师对我的作业很满意。
满意.example_en: The teacher is very satisfied with my homework.

难过.mnemonic: "难" hard to "过" pass through: a hard time to get past, feeling sad.
难过.components: 难: difficult; 过: 辶 walk + 寸 — to pass
难过.example_zh: 听到这个消息，他很难过。
难过.example_en: He was very sad to hear the news.

生气.mnemonic: "生" produce "气" steam: steam rising from your head, angry.
生气.components: 生: to produce, grow; 气: air, steam
生气.example_zh: 别生气了，我不是故意的。
生气.example_en: Don't be angry; I didn't do it on purpose.

害怕.mnemonic: Harm "害" in your house "宀" turns your heart "忄" pale white "白": afraid.
害怕.components: 害: 宀 roof + 丰-like + 口 — harm; 怕: 忄 heart + 白 white
害怕.example_en: My younger sister is afraid of dogs.

担心.mnemonic: A hand "扌" carrying a load at dawn "旦" on your heart "心": worrying.
担心.components: 担: 扌 hand + 旦 dawn (phonetic) — to carry; 心: heart
担心.example_en: Don't worry, I'll be back soon.

着急.mnemonic: Eyes "目" fixed, the heart "心" racing under a grabbing hand "彐": anxious.
着急.components: 着: 𦍌 + 目 eye — touch, feel; 急: ⺈ + 彐 hand + 心 heart — urgent
着急.example_en: It's still early, you don't need to rush.

放心.mnemonic: "放" let go, with a hand striking "攵", of your heart "心": put your mind at ease.
放心.components: 放: 方 direction + 攵 strike — release; 心: heart
放心.example_zh: 放心吧，我会照顾好自己的。
放心.example_en: Don't worry, I'll take good care of myself.

关心.mnemonic: "关" connect your heart "心" to someone: to care about.
关心.components: 关: close, concern; 心: heart

感兴趣.mnemonic: Feel "感" with the heart "心", rising "兴" interest, walk "走" to take "取" it: interested.
感兴趣.components: 感: 咸 + 心 heart — feel; 兴: rise, excitement; 趣: 走 walk + 取 take — interest
感兴趣.example_zh: 我对中国历史很感兴趣。
感兴趣.example_en: I'm very interested in Chinese history.

爱好.mnemonic: "爱" love and "好" a woman "女" with child "子": what you love to do, a hobby.
爱好.components: 爱: love; 好: 女 woman + 子 child — good, like

愿意.mnemonic: From your original "原" heart "心" and the heart's "意" wish: willing.
愿意.components: 愿: 原 origin + 心 heart — wish; 意: 音 sound + 心 heart — intention
愿意.example_en: Would you be willing to go with me?

饿.mnemonic: Food "饣" next to me "我": I need food, I'm hungry.
饿.components: 饿: 饣 food + 我 I, me

饱.mnemonic: Food "饣" wrapped up "包" in your belly: full.
饱.components: 饱: 饣 food + 包 wrap
饱.example_en: I'm full, I don't want to eat any more.

渴.mnemonic: Water "氵" next to a mouth "曷" calling out for it: thirsty.
渴.example_en: I'm very thirsty; I want to drink some water.

甜.mnemonic: The tongue "舌" tastes something sweet "甘": sweet.
甜.components: 甜: 舌 tongue + 甘 sweet

面包.mnemonic: "面" flour "包" wrapped into a loaf: bread.
面包.components: 面: flour, noodles (also face); 包: wrap, bun
面包.example_en: I ate a piece of bread this morning.

蛋糕.mnemonic: "蛋" egg (with insect "虫") and "糕" rice "米" with lamb "羔": an egg-and-flour cake.
蛋糕.components: 蛋: 疋 + 虫 insect — egg; 糕: 米 rice + 羔 lamb (phonetic) — cake
蛋糕.example_zh: 妈妈给我买了一个生日蛋糕。
蛋糕.example_en: Mom bought me a birthday cake.

香蕉.mnemonic: Fragrant "香" grain "禾" in the sun "日", grass "艹" over scorched "焦": a ripe banana.
香蕉.components: 香: 禾 grain + 日 sun — fragrant; 蕉: 艹 grass + 焦 scorched (phonetic) — banana plant
香蕉.example_en: I eat a banana every day.

葡萄.mnemonic: Two plants with grass tops "艹" crawling "匍" up a vine: grapes.
葡萄.components: 葡: 艹 plant + 匍 crawl (phonetic); 萄: 艹 plant + 匋 pottery (phonetic)
葡萄.example_en: These grapes are big and sweet.

啤酒.mnemonic: A mouth "口" drinking and water "氵" in a wine jar "酉": beer.
啤酒.components: 啤: 口 mouth + 卑 (phonetic); 酒: 氵 liquid + 酉 wine jar — alcohol
啤酒.example_zh: 爸爸晚饭时喜欢喝啤酒。
啤酒.example_en: Dad likes to drink beer at dinner.

饮料.mnemonic: "饮" food "饣" with an open mouth "欠" and "料" rice "米" in a measure "斗": a drink.
饮料.components: 饮: 饣 food + 欠 open mouth — to drink; 料: 米 rice + 斗 measure — material
饮料.example_en: What would you like to drink?

菜单.mnemonic: "菜" plants "艹" being picked "采" listed on a "单" single sheet: a menu.
菜单.components: 菜: 艹 plant + 采 pick — dish, vegetable; 单: list, single sheet
菜单.example_en: Waiter, please give us the menu.

慢.mnemonic: A heart '忄' dragging something long '曼' behind it can only move slowly.
慢.components: 忄 heart + 曼 long, drawn-out (phonetic)
慢.example_en: Please speak a little more slowly.

旁边.mnemonic: Stand at the side '旁' and walk '辶' with effort '力' along the edge: right beside it.
旁边.components: 旁 side (contains 方 direction) + 边 edge, side (辶 walk + 力 strength)
旁边.example_en: There is a shop next to my home.

左边.mnemonic: A hand '𠂇' holding a carpenter's tool '工' works on the left side '边'.
左边.components: 左 left (𠂇 hand + 工 work/tool) + 边 side (辶 walk + 力 strength)
左边.example_en: The hospital is to the left of the school.

右边.mnemonic: The hand '𠂇' that feeds your mouth '口' is your right hand, on the right side '边'.
右边.components: 右 right (𠂇 hand + 口 mouth) + 边 side (辶 walk + 力 strength)
右边.example_en: My friend is sitting on my right.

外.mnemonic: In the evening '夕', fortune-tellers '卜' did their readings outside under the sky.

远.mnemonic: Walking '辶' to the very beginning '元' of the road is a far journey.
远.example_en: The train station is far from here.

近.mnemonic: Walk '辶' just an axe '斤' throw away and you are already near.
近.example_en: My home is very close to the company.

离.mnemonic: Under a lid '亠', a trapped creature leaves tracks '禸' as it slips away from danger.
离.components: 亠 lid + 凶 + 禸 animal track (originally a net catching a bird)
离.example_en: The school isn't far from my home.

从.mnemonic: One person '人' follows another '人', coming from the same place.
从.components: 人 person + 人 person (one following another)

往.mnemonic: Take steps '彳' towards the master '主' who is calling you.
往.components: 彳 step + 主 master (originally phonetic)
往.example_en: Walk straight ahead and you'll be there.

公司.mnemonic: Dividing '八' private '厶' interests while a mouth '口' gives orders: that's a company.
公司.components: 公 public (八 divide + 厶 private) + 司 manage (𠃌 frame + 一 + 口 mouth)
公司.example_en: He works at a big company.

教室.mnemonic: A teacher with a stick '攵' teaches a child '子' who arrives '至' under the roof '宀': classroom.
教室.components: 教 teach (孝 filial: 耂 old + 子 child, + 攵 hand with stick) + 室 room (宀 roof + 至 arrive)
教室.example_en: Our classroom is on the second floor.

手机.mnemonic: A wooden '木' little machine '几' that sits in your hand '手': a mobile phone.
手机.components: 手 hand + 机 machine (木 wood + 几 small table)
手机.example_en: I can't find my mobile phone.

手表.mnemonic: Something worn on the outer surface '表' of your hand '手' wrist tells the time: a wristwatch.
手表.components: 手 hand + 表 surface; meter (contains 衣 clothing)
手表.example_zh: 这块手表是我妈妈送给我的。
手表.example_en: My mom gave me this wristwatch.

报纸.mnemonic: A hand '扌' reporting '报' the news onto silk-like '纟' paper '纸': a newspaper.
报纸.components: 报 report (扌 hand + 𠬝) + 纸 paper (纟 silk + 氏 phonetic)
报纸.example_zh: 我爸爸每天早上看报纸。
报纸.example_en: My dad reads the newspaper every morning.

晴.mnemonic: The sun '日' shines in a clear blue '青' sky: sunny.

阴.mnemonic: Only the pale moon '月' shows behind the hill '阝': dark and overcast.
阴.example_zh: 今天天气很阴，可能会下雨。
阴.example_en: It's very cloudy today; it might rain.

雪.mnemonic: Rain '雨' that you can sweep up with a hand-held broom '彐' is snow.

颜色.mnemonic: The face '页' blushes with colour '色' like a painted mask.
颜色.components: 颜 face (彦 + 页 head) + 色 colour (⺈ + 巴)

红.mnemonic: Workers '工' dye silk threads '纟' bright red for the festival.
红.example_en: She is wearing a red outfit.

白.mnemonic: The sun '日' with a single ray '丿' on top shines pure white.
白.example_en: The snow outside is very white.

黑.mnemonic: Fire '灬' below fills the chimney above with black soot.
黑.components: upper part a soot-filled chimney/window + 灬 fire
黑.example_en: It's dark now; let's go home.

新.mnemonic: Standing '立' by a tree '木' with an axe '斤', you cut fresh new wood.
新.components: 亲 (立 stand + 木 tree) + 斤 axe
新.example_en: This is my new mobile phone.

长.mnemonic: The shape shows an old man with long hair flowing in the wind.
长.components: 长 pictograph of a person with long hair

高.mnemonic: A tall tower: a roof '亠' on top, windows '口' stacked high above the gate '冂'.
高.components: 亠 roof + 口 + 冂 + 口 (pictograph of a tall tower)
高.example_en: My older brother is taller than me.

错.mnemonic: Metal '钅' left since ancient times '昔' rusts, a costly mistake.
错.components: 钅 metal + 昔 former times (phonetic)

对.mnemonic: Two hands '又' and '寸' match perfectly, facing each other: correct!

非常.mnemonic: Wings '非' spread wide beyond the usual '常' cloth banner: extremely unusual.
非常.components: 非 not (pictograph of spread wings) + 常 usual (尚 + 巾 cloth)

真.mnemonic: Ten '十' eyes '目' standing on legs '八' all see the same thing: it's really true.
真.components: 十 ten + 目 eye + 一 + 八 (legs)
真.example_en: The weather is really nice today!

课.mnemonic: Speech '讠' that bears fruit '果' in your mind is a good lesson.
课.example_en: We have two classes this afternoon.

考试.mnemonic: The old '耂' teacher tests your words '讠' against a formula '式': an exam.
考试.components: 考 test (耂 old + 丂) + 试 try (讠 speech + 式 formula)

题.mnemonic: Is it '是' right? A question that scratches your head '页'.

问题.mnemonic: A mouth '口' at the door '门' asks about a head-scratching '页' problem.
问题.components: 问 ask (门 door + 口 mouth) + 题 topic (是 + 页 head)

问.mnemonic: A mouth '口' poking through a door '门' to ask a question.

回答.mnemonic: Words go round '回' and fit together '合' like bamboo '⺮' slips: an answer.
回答.components: 回 return (口 inside 口) + 答 answer (⺮ bamboo + 合 fit together)

懂.mnemonic: When a heavy '重' idea sinks into your heart '忄', you finally understand.
懂.components: 忄 heart + 董 (艹 grass + 重 heavy; phonetic)
懂.example_en: Do you understand what I mean?

知道.mnemonic: Words shoot from the mouth '口' like an arrow '矢', leading the head '首' down the right road '辶'.
知道.components: 知 know (矢 arrow + 口 mouth) + 道 way (辶 walk + 首 head)
知道.example_zh: 我不知道他叫什么名字。
知道.example_en: I don't know what his name is.

觉得.mnemonic: You see '见' something and get '得' a feeling about it in one step '彳'.
觉得.components: 觉 feel (⺍ + 冖 + 见 see) + 得 get (彳 step + 日 + 一 + 寸 hand)
觉得.example_zh: 我觉得这件衣服很漂亮。
觉得.example_en: I think this piece of clothing is very pretty.

希望.mnemonic: Weaving rare cloth '布' while gazing at the moon '月' like a king '王': hoping.
希望.components: 希 rare, hope (㐅 + 布 cloth) + 望 gaze (亡 + 月 moon + 王 king)
希望.example_en: I hope it will be sunny tomorrow.

意思.mnemonic: The sound '音' of the heart '心' and the field '田' of thoughts in the heart '心' carry meaning.
意思.components: 意 idea (音 sound + 心 heart) + 思 think (田 field + 心 heart)

事情.mnemonic: A hand holding a tool '事' plus feelings of the heart '忄': matters to handle.
事情.components: 事 affair (hand holding a tool) + 情 feeling (忄 heart + 青 phonetic)
事情.example_zh: 我今天有很多事情要做。
事情.example_en: I have a lot of things to do today.

忙.mnemonic: So busy your heart '忄' feels like it's dying '亡'.
忙.example_en: Dad has been very busy with work lately.

介绍.mnemonic: A person '人' stands between two others and summons '召' them together with a silk thread '纟': introduce.
介绍.components: 介 between (人 person + two strokes) + 绍 connect (纟 silk + 召 summon)
介绍.example_zh: 我来介绍一下，这是我的朋友。
介绍.example_en: Let me introduce you; this is my friend.

告诉.mnemonic: A mouth '口' under an ox's horns announces '告' it, then speech '讠' explains: tell.
告诉.components: 告 announce (牛-like top + 口 mouth) + 诉 tell (讠 speech + 斥)
告诉.example_zh: 请你告诉我你的电话号码。
告诉.example_en: Please tell me your phone number.

帮助.mnemonic: A whole state '邦' gives cloth '巾', and strength '力' is added '且': help.
帮助.components: 帮 help (邦 state + 巾 cloth) + 助 assist (且 + 力 strength)

给.mnemonic: Silk '纟' threads brought together '合' as a gift you give.

送.mnemonic: Walk '辶' your friend to the gate '关' to see them off with a gift.
送.example_en: Let me take you to the airport.

让.mnemonic: Speech '讠' that lets someone go up '上' first: let.
让.example_en: Mom doesn't let me watch TV.

找.mnemonic: A hand '扌' holding a halberd '戈', searching for the enemy.

等.mnemonic: Waiting at the temple '寺' among the bamboo '⺮' for the monk to come out.

比.mnemonic: Two people '匕' '匕' stand side by side to compare heights.
比.components: 匕 + 匕 (two people side by side)

要.mnemonic: A woman '女' under a cover '覀' wants something important.
要.example_en: I want a cup of coffee.

可以.mnemonic: A mouth '口' says yes, and with a tool '以' you can do it.
可以.components: 可 can (丁 + 口 mouth) + 以 by means of (pictograph of a tool)

可能.mnemonic: A mouth '口' says it can be, and a strong bear '能' is able: possible.
可能.components: 可 can (丁 + 口 mouth) + 能 able (厶 + 月 + 匕匕; pictograph of a bear)

别.mnemonic: Another '另' person holds a knife '刂': don't come near!
别.example_en: Don't talk, the teacher is coming.

再.mnemonic: One '一' more layer stacked on the frame '冉': do it again.

一起.mnemonic: One '一' group gets up '起' and walks '走' off together, each self '己' included.
一起.components: 一 one + 起 rise (走 walk + 己 self)

一下.mnemonic: One '一' quick step down '下': just a bit, once.
一下.components: 一 one + 下 down (a line with a mark below)
一下.example_en: Take a look at this book.

每.mnemonic: Every '每' mother '母' wears a hat '𠂉' each day.

吧.mnemonic: A mouth '口' softly saying 'ba' '巴' to make a suggestion.

得.mnemonic: One step '彳' and a hand '寸' grabs the sun '日': it links action to how well it's done.
得.components: 彳 step + 日 sun + 一 + 寸 hand

着.mnemonic: A sheep '羊' keeps its eye '目' open, staring continuously.

过.mnemonic: Walk '辶' past every inch '寸' of the road: you've been through it before.

还.mnemonic: Walking '辶' and not '不' arriving yet: still going.

也.mnemonic: A curvy snake-like shape that slithers in too, joining the others.

就.mnemonic: In the capital '京', especially '尤' then, things happen right away.

最.mnemonic: Say '曰' and take '取' the ear '耳' with your hand '又': grab the most.
最.components: 曰 say + 取 take (耳 ear + 又 hand)

第一.mnemonic: Bamboo '⺮' slips put in order by the younger brother '弟', with number one '一' on top.
第一.components: 第 ordinal prefix (⺮ bamboo + 弟 younger brother) + 一 one
第一.example_en: He came first in the exam.

次.mnemonic: Yawn '欠' twice '冫' — each time counts as one occurrence.
次.components: 冫 two strokes (ice) + 欠 yawn
次.example_en: I have been to Beijing three times.

件.mnemonic: A person '亻' with an ox '牛' counts items one by one.
件.example_en: I bought a new piece of clothing.

为什么.mnemonic: For '为' what '什么'? A person '亻' with ten '十' questions asks why.
为什么.components: 为 for + 什 what (亻 person + 十 ten) + 么 suffix (丿 + 厶)

因为.mnemonic: A big '大' man trapped in a box '囗' is the cause, because of '为' it.
因为.components: 因 cause (囗 enclosure + 大 big) + 为 for
因为.example_en: Because it rained, I didn't go to school.

所以.mnemonic: At the door '户' with an axe '斤', and by means of '以' that, therefore you get in.
所以.components: 所 place (户 door + 斤 axe) + 以 by means of
所以.example_en: I was sick, so I didn't go to work.

虽然.mnemonic: Although '虽' the insect '虫' has a tiny mouth '口', it is so '然' like a dog '犬' by the fire '灬'.
虽然.components: 虽 although (口 mouth + 虫 insect) + 然 so (月 meat + 犬 dog + 灬 fire)
虽然.example_zh: 虽然很累，但是我很高兴。
虽然.example_en: Although I'm tired, I'm very happy.

但是.mnemonic: A person '亻' waits for dawn '旦', but the sun '日' says it is '是' not yet.
但是.components: 但 but (亻 person + 旦 dawn) + 是 is (日 sun + 疋-like bottom)
但是.example_zh: 我想去，但是我没有时间。
但是.example_en: I want to go, but I don't have time.

请假.mnemonic: You use polite speech '请' to request a 'false' day '假' off work — asking for leave.
请假.components: 请 please/request (讠 speech + 青 green) + 假 false; holiday (亻 person + 叚)
请假.example_zh: 我明天要去医院，所以想请假。
请假.example_en: I have to go to the hospital tomorrow, so I want to ask for leave.

迟到.mnemonic: Walking '辶' while measuring with a ruler '尺', you 'arrive' '到' too slowly — late again.
迟到.components: 迟 slow; late (辶 walk + 尺 ruler) + 到 arrive (至 reach + 刂 knife)

完成.mnemonic: Put the roof '宀' on the house and the halberd-shaped '成' says success — the job is completed.
完成.components: 完 finish (宀 roof + 元 origin) + 成 accomplish (戈 halberd-based character)

结束.mnemonic: Tie a silk '纟' knot and bind the tree bundle '束' — wrapped up, it's over.
结束.components: 结 tie; knot (纟 silk + 吉 lucky) + 束 bundle (木 tree bound with a cord 口)
结束.example_en: What time does the meeting end?

解决.mnemonic: Cut the ox '牛' horn '角' apart with a knife '刀', then decide firmly '决' — problem solved.
解决.components: 解 untie; separate (角 horn + 刀 knife + 牛 ox) + 决 decide (冫 ice + 夬)
解决.example_zh: 这个问题我们一起解决吧。

决定.mnemonic: Break the ice '冫' and settle under your roof '宀' — the decision is fixed.
决定.components: 决 decide (冫 ice + 夬) + 定 settle; fixed (宀 roof + 疋 foot)
决定.example_zh: 他决定明年去中国学习。
决定.example_en: He decided to go study in China next year.

打算.mnemonic: Your hand '扌' hits '打' the abacus while bamboo '竹' counting rods calculate '算' — making a plan.
打算.components: 打 hit; do (扌 hand + 丁 nail) + 算 calculate (竹 bamboo + 目 eye + 廾 two hands)
打算.example_en: What do you plan to do this weekend?

要求.mnemonic: A woman '女' under a cover '覀' wants '要' and begs '求' for a fur coat — a demand.
要求.components: 要 want (覀 cover + 女 woman) + 求 beg; seek (pictograph of a fur coat)
要求.example_zh: 老师要求我们每天写汉字。
要求.example_en: The teacher requires us to write Chinese characters every day.

需要.mnemonic: Rain '雨' falls on a bearded '而' farmer who wants '要' it — he truly needs it.
需要.components: 需 need (雨 rain + 而 beard) + 要 want (覀 cover + 女 woman)

机会.mnemonic: A wooden '木' machine '机' brings people '人' together under clouds '云' — a meeting chance appears.
机会.components: 机 machine; opportunity (木 wood + 几 small table) + 会 meet (人 person + 云 cloud)
机会.example_en: This is a very good opportunity.

重要.mnemonic: Something heavy '重' that a woman '女' wants '要' badly must be important.
重要.components: 重 heavy (person carrying a heavy load; looks like 千 over 里) + 要 want (覀 + 女 woman)
重要.example_en: Health is more important than money.

帮忙.mnemonic: A nation '邦' hands over cloth '巾' to a busy heart '忄' that's lost '亡' time — lending help.
帮忙.components: 帮 help (邦 nation + 巾 cloth) + 忙 busy (忄 heart + 亡 lose)
帮忙.example_zh: 你能帮忙搬一下桌子吗？
帮忙.example_en: Can you help move the table?

城市.mnemonic: Earth '土' walls built to completion '成' surround a busy market '市' — that's a city.
城市.components: 城 city wall (土 earth + 成 complete) + 市 market (亠 lid + 巾 cloth)
城市.example_zh: 上海是一个很大的城市。
城市.example_en: Shanghai is a very big city.

街道.mnemonic: Earth tiles '圭' line a crossroad '行', and a head '首' walks '辶' down the road — a street.
街道.components: 街 street (行 crossroads + 圭 earth tiles) + 道 road (辶 walk + 首 head)

超市.mnemonic: Walk '走' past the summons '召' of tiny shops into a super '超' market '市'.
超市.components: 超 surpass; super (走 walk + 召 summon) + 市 market (亠 + 巾 cloth)
超市.example_en: I'm going to the supermarket to buy some fruit.

银行.mnemonic: Silver '银' metal '钅' moves along the crossroads '行' of business — a bank.
银行.components: 银 silver (钅 metal + 艮) + 行 business; row (pictograph of a crossroads)
银行.example_en: The bank closes at five in the afternoon.

公园.mnemonic: Private '厶' land divided '八' for the public '公', enclosed '囗' as a garden '园' — a park.
公园.components: 公 public (八 divide + 厶 private) + 园 garden (囗 enclosure + 元 origin)
公园.example_en: We go running in the park in the morning.

地铁.mnemonic: Iron '铁' metal '钅' rails running through the earth '土' ground '地' — the subway.
地铁.components: 地 ground (土 earth + 也) + 铁 iron (钅 metal + 失 lose)
地铁.example_en: I take the subway to work every day.

地图.mnemonic: The ground '地' drawn inside a picture frame '囗' — a map.
地图.components: 地 ground (土 earth + 也) + 图 picture; diagram (囗 frame + 冬 winter)
地图.example_en: Do you have a map of Beijing?

站.mnemonic: A person stands '立' to occupy '占' a spot on the platform — waiting at the station.
站.example_en: The next stop is the train station.

骑.mnemonic: A strange '奇' sight: someone riding a horse '马' through town.
骑.example_en: He rides a bike to school every day.

起飞.mnemonic: Walk '走' yourself '己' to the runway, rise '起', and spread wings '飞' — takeoff!
起飞.components: 起 rise (走 walk + 己 self) + 飞 fly (pictograph of wings)
起飞.example_en: The plane is about to take off.

经过.mnemonic: Follow a silk '纟' thread as you walk '辶' an inch '寸' at a time — passing through.
经过.components: 经 pass through (纟 silk + 𢀖) + 过 pass (辶 walk + 寸 inch)
经过.example_en: I pass by that bookstore every day.

离开.mnemonic: The creature escapes the trap '离' and two hands '廾' lift the gate bar '一' open '开' — gone!
离开.components: 离 depart (亠 lid + 凶 + 禸 shape) + 开 open (一 bar + 廾 two hands)

附近.mnemonic: Hand over '付' items by the hill '阝', walking '辶' near the axe '斤' — everything's close by.
附近.components: 附 attach; near (阝 mound + 付 hand over) + 近 near (辶 walk + 斤 axe)
附近.example_en: There is a supermarket near my home.

方便.mnemonic: A square '方' tool that changes '更' things for a person '亻' — so convenient!
方便.components: 方 square; direction + 便 convenient (亻 person + 更 change)
方便.example_zh: 住在这里买东西很方便。
方便.example_en: Living here, shopping is very convenient.

环境.mnemonic: A jade '王' ring '环' circles the earth '土' to its very boundary '竟' — your surroundings.
环境.components: 环 ring; surround (王 jade + 不) + 境 border; area (土 earth + 竟 end)
环境.example_en: The surroundings here are very quiet.

地方.mnemonic: A square '方' patch of earth '土' ground '地' — a place.
地方.components: 地 ground (土 earth + 也) + 方 square; direction
地方.example_en: What place do you want to go to have fun?

东.mnemonic: The sun rising behind a tree — the traditional '東' shows 日 in 木 — points east.
东.components: simplified from 東 (日 sun behind 木 tree)
东.example_en: The sun comes up in the east.

西.mnemonic: A bird settles into its box-like nest '西' when the sun sets in the west.
西.components: pictograph of a bird on its nest (birds roost at sunset)
西.example_en: The bank is to the west of the school.

南.mnemonic: A warm hut '冂' with a cross '十' on top faces south toward the sun.
南.components: 十 + 冂 enclosure + 丷 + 干 (pictograph of a bell-like instrument)
南.example_en: My hometown is in the south of China.

北方.mnemonic: Two people '北' sit back to back, turning away from the cold northern direction '方'.
北方.components: 北 north (two people back to back) + 方 direction
北方.example_en: Winters in the north are very cold.

中间.mnemonic: An arrow '丨' pierces the middle '中' of a box, and sun '日' shines between gates '门'.
中间.components: 中 middle (口 pierced by 丨) + 间 between (门 gate + 日 sun)
中间.example_en: He sat between me and my mom.

向.mnemonic: A house '冂' with a window '口' facing towards the sun.
向.components: 冂 house frame + 口 window
向.example_en: Walk to the left and you'll be there.

国家.mnemonic: Jade '玉' guarded inside borders '囗', and a pig '豕' under every roof '宀' — a nation of homes.
国家.components: 国 country (囗 border + 玉 jade) + 家 home (宀 roof + 豕 pig)
国家.example_en: Which countries have you been to?

世界.mnemonic: Generations '世' spread across fields '田' and boundaries '介' — the whole world.
世界.components: 世 generation (three 十 joined) + 界 boundary (田 field + 介 between)
世界.example_en: I want to travel all over the world.

黄河.mnemonic: Yellow '黄' earthy water '氵' that can '可' flood the fields — the Yellow River.
黄河.components: 黄 yellow (pictograph, contains 由-like field) + 河 river (氵 water + 可 can)
黄河.example_zh: 黄河是中国第二长的河。
黄河.example_en: The Yellow River is China's second-longest river.

接.mnemonic: Reach out a hand '扌' to meet the arriving woman '妾' and pick her up.
接.components: 扌 hand + 妾 (立 stand + 女 woman)
接.example_en: I'll go pick you up at the airport.

带.mnemonic: A belt with a cloth '巾' pouch hanging down — carry things along with you.
带.components: pictograph of a belt with hanging cloth 巾
带.example_en: Don't forget to bring an umbrella when you go out.

见面.mnemonic: An eye '目' on legs '儿' sees '见' your face '面' — meeting in person.
