见面.components: 见 see (目 eye over 儿 legs) + 面 face (pictograph of a face)

遇到.mnemonic: Walking '辶' along, you bump into a monkey '禺' and arrive '到' together — an encounter.
遇到.components: 遇 meet by chance (辶 walk + 禺 monkey) + 到 arrive (至 + 刂)
遇到.example_zh: 我在路上遇到了老同学。
遇到.example_en: I ran into an old classmate on the way.

太阳.mnemonic: A big '大' extra dot '丶' of sun '日' shining by the hill '阝' — the sun.
太阳.components: 太 very; great (大 big + 丶 dot) + 阳 sun; sunny side (阝 hill + 日 sun)
太阳.example_en: The sun is really strong today.

月亮.mnemonic: A crescent moon '月' shining bright '亮' over a tall roof '亠' — the moon.
月亮.components: 月 moon (pictograph) + 亮 bright (亠 + 口 + 冖 + 几)
月亮.example_en: Tonight's moon is big and round.

云.mnemonic: Two lines '二' of sky with a curl '厶' of vapor drifting below — a cloud.
云.components: 二 two (sky) + 厶 curl of vapor
云.example_en: There are many white clouds in the sky.

刮风.mnemonic: Wind '风' so sharp it scrapes '刮' like a knife '刂' across your tongue '舌'.
刮风.components: 刮 scrape; blow (舌 tongue + 刂 knife) + 风 wind (几 + 㐅)
刮风.example_zh: 外面刮风了，多穿点衣服。
刮风.example_en: It's windy outside, put on more clothes.

树.mnemonic: A wooden '木' trunk paired '对' with branches — a tree.
树.example_en: There are many big trees in the park.

草.mnemonic: Sprouts '艹' popping up early '早' in the morning — grass.
草.example_en: Please don't walk on the grass.

花.mnemonic: A plant '艹' that changes '化' from bud to bloom — a flower; changing money means spending.

春.mnemonic: Three people '三人' basking under the sun '日' — spring has arrived.
春.components: 𡗗 (三 three + 人 person) + 日 sun
春.example_en: Spring has come and the weather is warmer.

夏.mnemonic: A big head '頁' over slow dragging feet '夂' — trudging through summer heat.
夏.components: head (from 頁) + 夂 slow feet
夏.example_en: Summers in Beijing are very hot.

秋.mnemonic: Grain '禾' turning fire '火' red and gold — autumn harvest.

冬.mnemonic: Slow dragging feet '夂' over two drops of ice '⺀' — winter.

季节.mnemonic: A child '子' of the grain '禾' grows through each segment '节' of the year — seasons.
季节.components: 季 season (禾 grain + 子 child) + 节 node; festival (艹 grass + 卩 seal)
季节.example_en: Which season do you like most?

变化.mnemonic: A hand '又' tweaks things '亦', and a standing person '亻' flips upside down '匕' — total change.
变化.components: 变 change (亦 also + 又 hand) + 化 transform (亻 person + 匕 upside-down person)
变化.example_en: This place has changed a lot in recent years.

出现.mnemonic: A sprout pushes out '出' of the pit, and you see '见' jade '王' — it appears!
出现.components: 出 go out (sprout rising from 凵 pit; looks like stacked 山) + 现 appear (王 jade + 见 see)
出现.example_en: A rainbow appeared in the sky.

爬山.mnemonic: Claws '爪' grip the rock as you crawl '爬' up three peaks '山' — hiking!
爬山.components: 爬 climb; crawl (爪 claw + 巴) + 山 mountain (pictograph of three peaks)

动物.mnemonic: Things '物' like an ox '牛' that move '动' with strength '力' — animals.
动物.components: 动 move (云 cloud + 力 strength) + 物 thing (牛 ox + 勿)
动物.example_zh: 我的女儿很喜欢小动物。
动物.example_en: My daughter really likes small animals.

熊猫.mnemonic: A bear '熊' with four paws '灬' that looks like a cat '猫' among sprouts '苗' — panda.
熊猫.components: 熊 bear (能 + 灬 four dots) + 猫 cat (犭 animal + 苗 sprout)

马.mnemonic: The shape '马' is a horse turned sideways: mane at the top, legs and tail sweeping down.
马.components: pictograph of a horse (simplified from 馬)

鸟.mnemonic: A bird '鸟' with a dot eye, hooked beak, and tail sweeping below.
鸟.components: pictograph of a bird (simplified from 鳥)
鸟.example_en: There is a little bird in the tree.

音乐.mnemonic: Stand '立' under the sun '日' and hear sound '音' from drums on a wooden stand '乐' — music.
音乐.components: 音 sound (立 stand + 日 sun) + 乐 music; happy (simplified from 樂, drums on a wooden stand)
音乐.example_en: I listen to music every evening.

游戏.mnemonic: A child '子' swimming '游' in water '氵' and a hand '又' waving a toy spear '戈' — playing games.
游戏.components: 游 swim; roam (氵 water + 斿 banner with 子 child) + 戏 play (又 hand + 戈 spear)
游戏.example_en: The children are playing a game.

节目.mnemonic: Each segment '节' you watch with your eye '目' is one program on TV.
节目.components: 节 segment; festival (艹 + 卩) + 目 eye; item
节目.example_zh: 这个电视节目很有意思。
节目.example_en: This TV program is very interesting.

比赛.mnemonic: Two people side by side '比' race for shells '贝' of prize money '赛' — a competition.
比赛.components: 比 compare (two 匕 people side by side) + 赛 compete (宀 roof + 共-like middle + 贝 shell/money)
比赛.example_en: There is a soccer match tomorrow.

参加.mnemonic: A big '大' person with flowing hair '彡' adds '加' strength '力' and voice '口' — joining in.
参加.components: 参 participate (厶 + 大 big + 彡 hair) + 加 add (力 strength + 口 mouth)

新闻.mnemonic: Freshly axed '斤' new '新' wood, and an ear '耳' at the gate '门' hearing — the news.
新闻.components: 新 new (亲 + 斤 axe) + 闻 hear (门 gate + 耳 ear)
新闻.example_en: Dad watches the news every morning.

声音.mnemonic: A scholar '士' strikes a chime '声' while standing '立' under the sun '日' — a sound rings out.
声音.components: 声 sound (士 + top of a stone chime) + 音 sound (立 stand + 日 sun)
声音.example_en: Please speak a little more quietly.

画.mnemonic: A field '田' sketched inside a frame '凵' with a line '一' on top — a drawing.
画.components: 一 line + 田 field + 凵 frame
画.example_en: The cat she drew is very beautiful.

节日.mnemonic: A special segment '节' of the calendar with a bright sun '日' — a festival day.
节日.components: 节 festival; segment (艹 + 卩) + 日 sun; day
节日.example_zh: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
节日.example_en: Spring Festival is the most important holiday in China.

周末.mnemonic: At the tip '末' of the tree '木' is the end of the week '周' — weekend.
周末.components: 周 week; circuit (冂 + 土 + 口) + 末 end (木 tree with a long top stroke at its tip)
周末.example_zh: 这个周末我们去看电影吧。
周末.example_en: Let's go see a movie this weekend.

祝.mnemonic: An older brother '兄' kneels at the altar '礻' with open mouth '口' — making a wish.
祝.components: 礻 altar + 兄 elder brother (口 mouth + 儿 person)

元.mnemonic: Two strokes '二' on top of legs '儿' — a person's head, the basic unit: one yuan.

角.mnemonic: An ox horn '角' with ridges inside — once small horn coins, a jiao is a tenth of a yuan.
角.example_en: One apple costs five yuan and five jiao.

分.mnemonic: A knife '刀' divides '八' a coin into tiny pieces — fen, the smallest unit.
分.example_zh: 他这次考试得了九十分。
分.example_en: He got ninety points on this test.

碗.mnemonic: A bowl carved from '石' stone, its rim curving round like '宛'.
碗.example_en: I ate two bowls of rice today.

盘子.mnemonic: A '舟' boat-shaped serving dish sitting on a '皿' vessel base: a plate.
盘子.components: 盘 plate (舟 boat + 皿 dish) + 子 noun suffix
盘子.example_en: Please put the plates on the table.

筷子.mnemonic: Two '⺮' bamboo sticks that move '快' quickly to grab food: chopsticks.
筷子.components: 筷 chopstick (⺮ bamboo + 快 quick) + 子 noun suffix

冰箱.mnemonic: A '箱' box where '冫' ice freezes '水' water: the refrigerator.
冰箱.components: 冰 ice (冫 ice + 水 water) + 箱 box (⺮ bamboo + 相 phonetic)
冰箱.example_en: There is still a lot of fruit in the fridge.

厨房.mnemonic: Under a '厂' shelter, a hand '寸' cooks '豆' beans in a '房' room: the kitchen.
厨房.components: 厨 kitchen (厂 shelter + 豆 bean + 寸 hand) + 房 room (户 door + 方)
厨房.example_en: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.

衬衫.mnemonic: '衤' clothing fitted to the '寸' inch, plus '衫' a garment with '彡' stitched lines: a shirt.
衬衫.components: 衬 lining (衤 clothing + 寸 inch) + 衫 garment (衤 clothing + 彡 strokes)
衬衫.example_zh: 他今天穿了一件白衬衫。
衬衫.example_en: He is wearing a white shirt today.

裤子.mnemonic: '衤' clothing that stores your legs like a '库' warehouse: trousers.
裤子.components: 裤 trousers (衤 clothing + 库 storehouse) + 子 noun suffix
裤子.example_en: These trousers are a bit long.

裙子.mnemonic: Elegant '衤' clothing fit for a '君' noble lady: a skirt.
裙子.components: 裙 skirt (衤 clothing + 君 lord) + 子 noun suffix
裙子.example_zh: 她买了一条红色的裙子。

帽子.mnemonic: A '巾' cloth that '冒' covers the top of your head: a hat.
帽子.components: 帽 hat (巾 cloth + 冒 cover/emerge) + 子 noun suffix
帽子.example_en: It's cold outside, put on a hat.

皮鞋.mnemonic: '皮' skin tanned into '革' leather and shaped into '鞋' shoes: leather shoes.
皮鞋.components: 皮 skin, leather + 鞋 shoe (革 leather + 圭 phonetic)
皮鞋.example_zh: 我爸爸每天穿皮鞋上班。
皮鞋.example_en: My dad wears leather shoes to work every day.

伞.mnemonic: Look: a '人' canopy on top, ribs '丷' below, and a '十' handle: an open umbrella.
伞.components: pictograph of an umbrella: 人 canopy + 丷 ribs + 十 shaft
伞.example_en: It's raining, don't forget to bring an umbrella.

包.mnemonic: '勹' wraps around '巳' something inside, like a bag holding its contents.
包.example_en: Your bag is on the chair.

行李箱.mnemonic: A '箱' box for things you carry when you '行' travel, packed with '李' plums: a suitcase.
行李箱.components: 行 travel + 李 plum (木 tree + 子) + 箱 box; 行李 = luggage

护照.mnemonic: A '扌' hand guarding the '户' door, plus '照' a photo ID: the passport protects you abroad.
护照.components: 护 protect (扌 hand + 户 door) + 照 photo, certificate (昭 + 灬 fire)
护照.example_zh: 出国的时候一定要带护照。
护照.example_en: You must bring your passport when you go abroad.

信用卡.mnemonic: A '卡' card you '用' use because the bank '信' trusts your word: a credit card.
信用卡.components: 信 trust (亻 person + 言 words) + 用 use + 卡 card (上 + 下)
信用卡.example_en: Can I use a credit card here?

照相机.mnemonic: A '机' machine that '照' shines light to capture a '相' look: a camera.
照相机.components: 照 shine, photograph + 相 appearance (木 tree + 目 eye) + 机 machine (木 + 几)
照相机.example_zh: 他带着照相机去旅游了。
照相机.example_en: He took his camera on the trip.

照片.mnemonic: Light '照' shines and freezes a thin '片' slice of time: a photo.
照片.components: 照 shine, photograph (昭 + 灬 fire) + 片 slice, piece
照片.example_zh: 这张照片是在北京照的。
照片.example_en: This photo was taken in Beijing.

礼物.mnemonic: A '物' thing, like an '牛' ox, offered at the '礻' altar as a courtesy: a gift.
礼物.components: 礼 courtesy, ritual (礻 spirit + 乚) + 物 thing (牛 ox + 勿)
礼物.example_zh: 这是我送给你的生日礼物。
礼物.example_en: This is the birthday present I'm giving you.

笔记本.mnemonic: A '本' book where your '笔' bamboo brush '记' records notes: a notebook.
笔记本.components: 笔 pen (⺮ bamboo + 毛 hair) + 记 record (讠 speech + 己 self) + 本 book (木 + 一)

灯.mnemonic: A '火' fire hung on a '丁' nail lights up the room: a lamp.
灯.example_en: Please turn off the light before going to bed.

空调.mnemonic: A machine that '调' adjusts the '空' empty air in a cave: an air conditioner.
空调.components: 空 empty, air (穴 cave + 工 work) + 调 adjust (讠 speech + 周)
空调.example_zh: 天气太热了，快开空调吧！
空调.example_en: It's too hot, turn on the air conditioner!

蓝.mnemonic: The '艹' indigo plant you '监' watch over yields blue dye.
蓝.components: 艹 grass/plant + 监 (phonetic, to oversee)
蓝.example_en: The sky is especially blue today.

绿.mnemonic: '纟' silk threads dyed the color of spring leaves: green.
绿.example_en: Spring has come and the trees have all turned green.

打扫.mnemonic: A '扌' hand hits like a hammer '丁', another '扌' hand holds a '彐' broom: cleaning.
打扫.components: 打 hit, do (扌 hand + 丁 nail) + 扫 sweep (扌 hand + 彐 broom-hand)
打扫.example_zh: 我们周末一起打扫房间吧。
打扫.example_en: Let's clean the room together this weekend.

搬.mnemonic: A '扌' hand moves things the way a '般' boat carries cargo.
搬.example_en: He is moving house next month.

放.mnemonic: A hand '攵' sets something down in its '方' place: to put.
放.components: 方 direction, place + 攵 hand action
放.example_en: Where did you put the keys?

拿.mnemonic: A '手' hand '合' closes around something: to take or hold.
拿.components: 合 close, join + 手 hand
拿.example_en: Please hold this book for me.

关.mnemonic: Picture '丷' two bolts sliding across a '天' gate: to close.
关.components: 丷 + 天 (simplified from 關: 門 door + bolt)
关.example_zh: 出门的时候别忘了关门。
关.example_en: Don't forget to close the door when you go out.

换.mnemonic: A '扌' hand swaps one thing for a shinier '奂' one: to change.
换.example_zh: 我想换一件大一点儿的衣服。
换.example_en: I'd like to exchange it for a slightly bigger piece of clothing.

借.mnemonic: A '亻' person borrows something from the '昔' past and must return it.
借.components: 亻 person + 昔 former times (phonetic)
借.example_zh: 我可以借你的笔用一下吗？
借.example_en: Can I borrow your pen for a moment?

用.mnemonic: '用' looks like a sturdy bucket you use every day.
用.components: single pictograph, often explained as a bucket or fence
用.example_en: Do you know how to use this computer?

洗手间.mnemonic: The '间' room behind the '门' door where you '洗' wash your '手' hands: the restroom.
洗手间.components: 洗 wash (氵 water + 先) + 手 hand + 间 room (门 door + 日 sun)
洗手间.example_en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

电梯.mnemonic: A '梯' wooden ladder powered by '电' electricity: the elevator.
电梯.components: 电 electricity (lightning pictograph) + 梯 ladder (木 wood + 弟)

楼.mnemonic: '木' timber stacked up story after story '娄': a building.
楼.example_en: My family lives on the sixth floor.

层.mnemonic: Under a '尸' roof, layers pile up like '云' clouds: floors of a building.
层.example_en: This building has twenty floors in total.

照顾.mnemonic: Shine '照' light on someone and turn your '页' head to watch over them: take care.
照顾.components: 照 shine, look after + 顾 look back (厄 + 页 head)
照顾.example_zh: 姐姐在家照顾生病的妈妈。
照顾.example_en: My older sister is at home taking care of our sick mother.

小心.mnemonic: Keep your '心' heart '小' small and alert: be careful.
小心.example_en: There's ice on the road, be careful!

习惯.mnemonic: '习' practice something until it is '贯' threaded through your '忄' heart: a habit.
习惯.components: 习 practice (simplified from 習 wings) + 惯 accustomed (忄 heart + 贯 string through)
习惯.example_zh: 我已经习惯了这里的天气。
习惯.example_en: I've already gotten used to the weather here.

班.mnemonic: A '刂' knife splits jade '王' between two '王' halves: dividing people into classes.
班.components: 王 jade + 刂 knife + 王 jade
班.example_en: There are thirty students in our class.

年级.mnemonic: Each '年' year you climb one '级' step on the silk '纟' ladder: school grade.
年级.components: 年 year + 级 level (纟 silk + 及 reach)
年级.example_en: My younger brother is in third grade this year.

黑板.mnemonic: A '木' wooden '板' board painted '黑' black like soot over fire.
黑板.components: 黑 black (soot over 灬 fire) + 板 board (木 wood + 反)
黑板.example_zh: 老师在黑板上写了几个字。
黑板.example_en: The teacher wrote a few characters on the blackboard.

作业.mnemonic: A '亻' person '作' doing their '业' work after school: homework.
作业.components: 作 do, make (亻 person + 乍) + 业 work, task

复习.mnemonic: '复' again and again you '习' flap your wings to practice: to review.
复习.components: 复 again, repeat + 习 practice
复习.example_en: You should review well before the exam.

练习.mnemonic: Twisting '纟' silk over and over, you '习' practice the skill: to practice.
练习.components: 练 train (纟 silk + 东) + 习 practice
练习.example_en: I practice speaking Chinese every day.

成绩.mnemonic: What you '成' complete, '绩' spun like silk '纟' into results: your grade.
成绩.components: 成 accomplish + 绩 achievement (纟 silk + 责 duty)
成绩.example_zh: 他这次考试的成绩很好。
成绩.example_en: He got a very good score on this exam.

数学.mnemonic: A hand '攵' counting '数' things while a child '子' learns '学': mathematics.
数学.components: 数 number, count (娄 + 攵 hand) + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子 child)

历史.mnemonic: Under a '厂' cliff, '力' strength passes through time, and a hand holds the '史' record: history.
历史.components: 历 pass through (厂 cliff + 力 strength) + 史 history (hand holding a record)

体育.mnemonic: Training a '亻' person's '本' body to '育' raise a strong child: sports and PE.
体育.components: 体 body (亻 person + 本 root) + 育 raise (𠫓 child + 月 flesh)
体育.example_zh: 我们星期三下午有体育课。
体育.example_en: We have PE class on Wednesday afternoon.

词语.mnemonic: '讠' Speech managed by '司' an official and '吾' my own speech: words and expressions.
词语.components: 词 word (讠 speech + 司 manage) + 语 language (讠 speech + 吾 I)

句子.mnemonic: A '口' mouth '勹' wrapped into one complete thought: a sentence.
句子.components: 句 sentence (勹 wrap + 口 mouth) + 子 noun suffix
句子.example_zh: 请用这个词写一个句子。
句子.example_en: Please write a sentence using this word.

字典.mnemonic: A '典' classic book on a stand listing every '字' character, a child '子' under a '宀' roof.
字典.components: 字 character (宀 roof + 子 child) + 典 classic, book on a stand
字典.example_zh: 不认识的字可以查字典。
字典.example_en: You can look up characters you don't know in a dictionary.

普通话.mnemonic: '话' Speech from the '舌' tongue that '通' passes '普' everywhere: Mandarin.
普通话.components: 普 universal (並 + 日 sun) + 通 pass through (辶 walk + 甬) + 话 speech (讠 + 舌 tongue)
普通话.example_zh: 他的普通话说得非常好。

中文.mnemonic: The '文' writing of the '中' Middle Kingdom, a line through its center: Chinese.
中文.components: 中 middle (line through a box) + 文 writing, culture
中文.example_en: I have studied Chinese for two years.

图书馆.mnemonic: A '馆' hall full of '图' pictures and '书' books: the library.
图书馆.components: 图 picture (囗 enclosure + 冬) + 书 book + 馆 hall (饣 food + 官 official)
图书馆.example_en: I often go to the library to read.

水平.mnemonic: '水' Water always lies '平' flat, a perfect level: standard.
水平.components: 水 water + 平 flat, level
水平.example_zh: 他的汉语水平提高得很快。
水平.example_en: His Chinese level has improved quickly.

教.mnemonic: An elder '耂' guides a '子' child with a '攵' hand: to teach.
教.components: 耂 elder + 子 child + 攵 hand action

讲.mnemonic: '讠' Words drawn up steadily like water from a '井' well: to explain.
讲.example_zh: 爷爷给我讲了一个故事。

明白.mnemonic: '日' Sun plus '月' moon make it bright, and '白' white is clear: to understand.
明白.components: 明 bright (日 sun + 月 moon) + 白 white, clear
明白.example_en: Do you understand what I mean?

清楚.mnemonic: '氵' Water so '青' clear you can see through the '林' woods: clear.
清楚.components: 清 clear (氵 water + 青 blue-green) + 楚 distinct (林 woods + 疋)
清楚.example_en: The teacher explained it very clearly.

了解.mnemonic: Use a '刀' knife to cut apart an '牛' ox's '角' horn and '了' finish: understand fully.
了解.components: 了 finish + 解 untie, explain (角 horn + 刀 knife + 牛 ox)
了解.example_zh: 我想多了解一下中国文化。
了解.example_en: I want to learn more about Chinese culture.

记得.mnemonic: '记' Record it with '讠' words so you '得' get to keep it: remember.
记得.components: 记 record (讠 speech + 己 self) + 得 obtain (彳 step + 㝵)
记得.example_en: Do you still remember his name?

忘记.mnemonic: The '心' heart has '亡' lost what you '记' recorded: forget.
忘记.components: 忘 forget (亡 lost + 心 heart) + 记 record (讠 speech + 己 self)
忘记.example_en: I forgot to bring my keys.

相信.mnemonic: A '亻' person's '言' words seen '相' eye to eye: to trust.
相信.components: 相 mutual (木 tree + 目 eye) + 信 trust (亻 person + 言 words)
相信.example_en: I believe you can definitely do it well.

认为.mnemonic: A '人' person puts it into '讠' words and '为' acts on it: to think.
认为.components: 认 recognize (讠 speech + 人 person) + 为 do, as
认为.example_en: I think this method is very good.

发现.mnemonic: Something '发' sent out suddenly appears '现' as shining '王' jade you '见' see: discover.
发现.components: 发 send out + 现 appear (王 jade + 见 see)
发现.example_zh: 我发现他今天不太高兴。
发现.example_en: I noticed he isn't very happy today.

提高.mnemonic: A '扌' hand lifts something up to a '高' tall tower: to raise.
提高.components: 提 lift (扌 hand + 是) + 高 tall (tower pictograph)
提高.example_zh: 我想提高我的汉语水平。
提高.example_en: I want to improve my Chinese level.

故事.mnemonic: '古' Old '事' affairs retold by hand '攵': a story.
故事.components: 故 old, past (古 ancient + 攵 hand) + 事 matter, affair

文化.mnemonic: '文' Writing that '化' transforms a '亻' person: culture.
文化.components: 文 writing, pattern + 化 change (亻 person + 匕)
文化.example_zh: 我对中国文化很感兴趣。
文化.example_en: I'm very interested in Chinese culture.

办法.mnemonic: Use '力' strength to '办' handle it, following '氵' water's path '去': a method.
办法.components: 办 handle (力 strength + two dots) + 法 method, law (氵 water + 去 go)
办法.example_zh: 别担心，我们一定有办法。
办法.example_en: Don't worry, we'll definitely find a way.

其实.mnemonic: Under the '宀' roof is the '头' real head of the matter: '其实' actually.
其实.components: 其 its, that + 实 real (宀 roof + 头 head)
其实.example_zh: 其实我不太喜欢吃辣的。
其实.example_en: Actually, I don't really like spicy food.

办公室.mnemonic: A '室' room under a '宀' roof where you '办' handle '公' public business: an office.
办公室.components: 办 handle (力 strength) + 公 public (八 + 厶) + 室 room (宀 roof + 至 arrive)
办公室.example_en: The manager is in the office now.

会议.mnemonic: '人' People '会' gather and '议' discuss with '讠' words: a meeting.
会议.components: 会 meet (人 person + 云) + 议 discuss (讠 speech + 义 meaning)
会议.example_zh: 明天上午有一个重要的会议。
会议.example_en: There is an important meeting tomorrow morning.

电子邮件.mnemonic: An '件' item sent by '邮' post through '电' electric wires: email.
电子邮件.components: 电 electric + 子 suffix + 邮 post (由 + 阝 town) + 件 item (亻 person + 牛 ox)
电子邮件.example_zh: 我昨天给你发了一封电子邮件。
电子邮件.example_en: I sent you an email yesterday.

上网.mnemonic: Climb '上' up onto the '网' net, a web of crossed lines: go online.
上网.components: 上 up, go onto + 网 net (冂 frame + crossed lines)
上网.example_zh: 我每天晚上上网看新闻。
上网.example_en: I go online to read the news every evening.
